**001-texto rico.html**
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>Texto enriquecido | Componentes visuales</title>
    <style>
      :root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827}
      *{box-sizing:border-box}
      body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);display:grid;place-items:start center;background:#f3f6fb;color:var(--negro);font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
      textarea{width:min(100%,720px);min-height:min(65vh,480px);padding:18px;border:2px solid #d5deed;border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:14px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif;resize:vertical;box-shadow:0 12px 32px #11182714}
      textarea:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;border-color:var(--azul)}
      @media(max-width:600px){body{padding:16px}textarea{min-height:60vh;padding:14px;font-size:15px}}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <textarea aria-label="Texto enriquecido"></textarea>
  </body>
</html>

```
**002-andreitextorico.html**
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>Editor de texto | Componente visual</title>
    <style>
      :root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827}
      *{box-sizing:border-box}
      body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);display:grid;place-items:start center;background:#f3f6fb;color:var(--negro);font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
      .jocarsa-texto{width:min(100%,680px)}
      .jocarsa-texto article{
        width:100%;
        min-height:min(65vh,480px);
        padding:18px;
        border:2px solid #d5deed;
        border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);
        border-radius:14px;
        background:var(--blanco);
        color:var(--negro);
        font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif;
        overflow:auto;
        box-shadow:0 12px 32px #11182714;
      }
      .jocarsa-texto article:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;border-color:var(--azul)}
      @media(max-width:600px){body{padding:16px}.jocarsa-texto article{min-height:60vh;padding:14px;font-size:15px}}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <jocarsa-texto></jocarsa-texto>
  </body>
  <script>
    let elementos = document.querySelectorAll("jocarsa-texto");
		elementos.forEach(function(elemento){
    	let elementoenmemoria = elemento
      let contenedor = document.createElement("div")
      contenedor.classList.add("jocarsa-texto")
      elementoenmemoria.after(contenedor);
      elemento.remove()
      let contenedor_rico = document.createElement("article")
      let contenedor_pobre = document.createElement("textarea")
      contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_rico)
      contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_pobre)
      contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none"
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("contenteditable",true)
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("role","textbox")
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-label","Editor de texto")
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-multiline","true")
    })
  </script>
</html>
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>Editor sincronizado | Componente visual</title>
    <style>
      :root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827}
      *{box-sizing:border-box}
      body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);display:grid;place-items:start center;background:#f3f6fb;color:var(--negro);font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
      .jocarsa-texto{width:min(100%,680px)}
      .jocarsa-texto article{
        width:100%;
        min-height:min(65vh,480px);
        padding:18px;
        border:2px solid #d5deed;
        border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);
        border-radius:14px;
        background:var(--blanco);
        color:var(--negro);
        font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif;
        overflow:auto;
        box-shadow:0 12px 32px #11182714;
      }
      .jocarsa-texto article:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;border-color:var(--azul)}
      @media(max-width:600px){body{padding:16px}.jocarsa-texto article{min-height:60vh;padding:14px;font-size:15px}}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <jocarsa-texto></jocarsa-texto>
  </body>
  <script>
    let elementos = document.querySelectorAll("jocarsa-texto");
		elementos.forEach(function(elemento){
    	let elementoenmemoria = elemento
      let contenedor = document.createElement("div")
      contenedor.classList.add("jocarsa-texto")
      elementoenmemoria.after(contenedor);
      elemento.remove()
      let contenedor_rico = document.createElement("article")
      let contenedor_pobre = document.createElement("textarea")
      contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_rico)
      contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_pobre)
      contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none"
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("contenteditable",true)
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("role","textbox")
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-label","Editor de texto")
      contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-multiline","true")
      contenedor_rico.oninput = function(){
      	contenedor_pobre.value = contenedor_rico.innerHTML
      }
    })
  </script>
</html>
```

**004-pongo un boton.html**
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>Formato de texto | Componente visual</title>
    <style>
      :root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827}
      *{box-sizing:border-box}
      body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);display:grid;place-items:start center;background:#f3f6fb;color:var(--negro);font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
      .jocarsa-texto{width:min(100%,680px);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d5deed;border-radius:14px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 12px 32px #11182714;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
      .jocarsa-texto .barra{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px;background:#f3f6fb;border-bottom:1px solid #d5deed}
      .jocarsa-texto button{min-width:36px;height:36px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,color .15s ease}
      .jocarsa-texto button:hover{border-color:var(--azul);background:var(--azul);color:var(--blanco)}
      .jocarsa-texto article{width:100%;min-height:min(65vh,480px);padding:18px;overflow:auto;outline:none;color:var(--negro);font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif}
      .jocarsa-texto article:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833}
      .jocarsa-texto textarea{width:100%;min-height:200px;padding:14px;border:0;border-top:1px solid #d5deed;color:var(--negro);font:14px/1.5 Consolas,monospace}
      @media(max-width:600px){body{padding:16px}.jocarsa-texto article{min-height:60vh;padding:14px;font-size:15px}.jocarsa-texto .barra{gap:5px;padding:8px}.jocarsa-texto button{min-width:34px;height:36px}}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <jocarsa-texto></jocarsa-texto>
    <script>
      let elementos = document.querySelectorAll("jocarsa-texto");
      elementos.forEach(function(elemento){
        let elementoenmemoria = elemento;
        let contenedor = document.createElement("div");
        contenedor.classList.add("jocarsa-texto");
        elementoenmemoria.after(contenedor);
        elemento.remove();
        let boton_negrita = document.createElement("button");
        boton_negrita.type = "button";
        boton_negrita.textContent = "B";
        boton_negrita.setAttribute("aria-label","Aplicar negrita");
        contenedor.appendChild(boton_negrita);
        boton_negrita.onclick = function(){
          console.log("Te pongo el texto seleccionado en negrita");
        };
        let contenedor_rico = document.createElement("article");
        let contenedor_pobre = document.createElement("textarea");
        contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_rico);
        contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_pobre);
        contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none";
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("contenteditable",true);
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("role","textbox");
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-label","Editor de texto");
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-multiline","true");
        contenedor_rico.oninput = function(){
          contenedor_pobre.value = contenedor_rico.innerHTML;
        };
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>Editor enriquecido | Componente visual</title>

  </head>

  <body>

    <andrei-texto></andrei-texto>

    <script>

      let elementos = document.querySelectorAll("andrei-texto");

      elementos.forEach(function(elemento){

        let elementoenmemoria = elemento;

        // Contenedor principal
        let contenedor = document.createElement("div");
        contenedor.classList.add("andrei-texto");

        elementoenmemoria.after(contenedor);
        elemento.remove();


        // ==============================
        // BARRA DE HERRAMIENTAS
        // ==============================

        let barra = document.createElement("div");
        barra.classList.add("barra");
        barra.setAttribute("role", "toolbar");
        barra.setAttribute("aria-label", "Formato de texto");

        contenedor.appendChild(barra);


        // Función para crear botones
        function crearBoton(texto, comando, valor = null){

          let boton = document.createElement("button");

          boton.type = "button";
          boton.innerHTML = texto;
          const nombresFormato = {
            bold: "negrita",
            italic: "cursiva",
            underline: "subrayado",
            strikeThrough: "tachado",
            formatBlock: "bloque " + valor,
            insertUnorderedList: "lista con viñetas",
            insertOrderedList: "lista numerada",
            justifyLeft: "alinear a la izquierda",
            justifyCenter: "centrar",
            justifyRight: "alinear a la derecha",
            undo: "deshacer",
            redo: "rehacer"
          };
          boton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Aplicar " + nombresFormato[comando]);

          barra.appendChild(boton);

          boton.onclick = function(){

            document.execCommand(
              comando,
              false,
              valor
            );

            contenedor_rico.focus();

            actualizarHTML();
          };

          return boton;
        }


        // ==============================
        // BOTONES
        // ==============================

        crearBoton("<b>B</b>", "bold");

        crearBoton("<i>I</i>", "italic");

        crearBoton("<u>U</u>", "underline");

        crearBoton("<s>S</s>", "strikeThrough");

        crearBoton("H1", "formatBlock", "h1");

        crearBoton("H2", "formatBlock", "h2");

        crearBoton("P", "formatBlock", "p");

        crearBoton("•", "insertUnorderedList");

        crearBoton("1.", "insertOrderedList");

        crearBoton("←", "justifyLeft");

        crearBoton("↔", "justifyCenter");

        crearBoton("→", "justifyRight");

        crearBoton("↶", "undo");

        crearBoton("↷", "redo");


        // ==============================
        // BOTÓN ENLACE
        // ==============================

        let boton_enlace = document.createElement("button");

        boton_enlace.type = "button";
        boton_enlace.textContent = "🔗";
        boton_enlace.setAttribute("aria-label", "Insertar enlace");

        barra.appendChild(boton_enlace);

        boton_enlace.onclick = function(){

          let url = prompt("Introduce la URL:");

          if(url){

            document.execCommand(
              "createLink",
              false,
              url
            );

          }

          actualizarHTML();
        };


        // ==============================
        // QUITAR FORMATO
        // ==============================

        let boton_limpiar = document.createElement("button");

        boton_limpiar.type = "button";
        boton_limpiar.textContent = "Tx";
        boton_limpiar.setAttribute("aria-label", "Quitar formato");

        barra.appendChild(boton_limpiar);

        boton_limpiar.onclick = function(){

          document.execCommand(
            "removeFormat",
            false,
            null
          );

          actualizarHTML();
        };


        // ==============================
        // EDITOR VISUAL
        // ==============================

        let contenedor_rico = document.createElement("article");

        contenedor_rico.setAttribute(
          "contenteditable",
          "true"
        );
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("role", "textbox");
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-label", "Editor de texto");
        contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-multiline", "true");

        contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_rico);


        // ==============================
        // TEXTAREA HTML
        // ==============================

        let contenedor_pobre = document.createElement("textarea");
        contenedor_pobre.setAttribute("aria-label", "Código HTML del texto");

        contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_pobre);

        contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none";


        // ==============================
        // SINCRONIZACIÓN
        // ==============================

        function actualizarHTML(){

          contenedor_pobre.value =
            contenedor_rico.innerHTML;

        }

        contenedor_rico.oninput = function(){

          actualizarHTML();

        };


        // ==============================
        // MOSTRAR / OCULTAR HTML
        // ==============================

        let boton_html = document.createElement("button");

        boton_html.type = "button";
        boton_html.textContent = "</>";
        boton_html.setAttribute("aria-label", "Mostrar u ocultar código HTML");

        barra.appendChild(boton_html);

        boton_html.onclick = function(){

          if(contenedor_pobre.style.display == "none"){

            actualizarHTML();

            contenedor_pobre.style.display = "block";
            contenedor_rico.style.display = "none";

          }else{

            contenedor_rico.innerHTML =
              contenedor_pobre.value;

            contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none";
            contenedor_rico.style.display = "block";

          }

        };

      });

    </script>

  </body>
</html>
```

**andrei-texto.css**
```css
:root{
  --naranja:#f97316;
  --azul:#1d4ed8;
  --blanco:#fff;
  --negro:#111827;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}

body{
  min-height:100vh;
  margin:0;
  padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);
  display:grid;
  place-items:start center;
  background:#f3f6fb;
  color:var(--negro);
  font-family:Arial,sans-serif;
}

.andrei-texto{
  width:min(100%,680px);
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #d5deed;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--blanco);
  box-shadow:0 12px 32px #11182714;
}

.andrei-texto .barra{
  display:flex;
  gap:6px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:10px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d5deed;
  background:#f3f6fb;
}

.andrei-texto button{
  min-width:36px;
  min-height:36px;
  padding:0 9px;
  cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--blanco);
  color:var(--negro);
  font-weight:600;
  transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,color .15s ease;
}

.andrei-texto button:hover,
.andrei-texto button:focus-visible{
  border-color:var(--azul);
  background:var(--azul);
  color:var(--blanco);
}

.andrei-texto button:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.andrei-texto article{
  width:100%;
  min-height:min(65vh,480px);
  padding:18px;
  overflow:auto;
  outline:none;
  color:var(--negro);
  font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif;
}

.andrei-texto article:focus{
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #1d4ed833;
}

.andrei-texto textarea{
  width:100%;
  min-height:200px;
  padding:14px;
  border:0;
  border-top:1px solid #d5deed;
  color:var(--negro);
  font:14px/1.5 Consolas,monospace;
  resize:vertical;
}

form{
  display:grid;
  gap:10px;
  width:min(100%,680px);
  padding:clamp(16px,4vw,28px);
  border:1px solid #d5deed;
  border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);
  border-radius:16px;
  background:var(--blanco);
  box-shadow:0 12px 32px #11182714;
}

form input[type="text"]{
  width:100%;
  min-height:44px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border:1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius:8px;
  color:var(--negro);
  font:16px Arial,sans-serif;
}

form input[type="text"]:focus{
  outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;
  border-color:var(--azul);
}

form input[type="submit"]{
  justify-self:start;
  min-height:44px;
  padding:0 20px;
  cursor:pointer;
  border:0;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--naranja);
  color:var(--blanco);
  font:700 15px Arial,sans-serif;
}

form input[type="submit"]:hover{background:#ea580c}

@media(max-width:600px){
  body{padding:16px}
  .andrei-texto article{min-height:60vh;padding:14px;font-size:15px}
  .andrei-texto .barra{gap:5px;padding:8px}
  .andrei-texto button{min-width:34px;min-height:36px;padding:0 8px}
}

```

```js
let elementos = document.querySelectorAll("jocarsa-texto");

elementos.forEach(function(elemento){

  let elementoenmemoria = elemento;

  // Guardamos los atributos importantes
  // ANTES de eliminar el elemento original
  let nombre = elementoenmemoria.getAttribute("name");


  // ==============================
  // CONTENEDOR PRINCIPAL
  // ==============================

  let contenedor = document.createElement("div");

  contenedor.classList.add("jocarsa-texto");

  elementoenmemoria.after(contenedor);

  elemento.remove();


  // ==============================
  // BARRA DE HERRAMIENTAS
  // ==============================

  let barra = document.createElement("div");

  barra.classList.add("barra");
  barra.setAttribute("role", "toolbar");
  barra.setAttribute("aria-label", "Formato de texto");

  contenedor.appendChild(barra);


  // ==============================
  // FUNCIÓN PARA CREAR BOTONES
  // ==============================

  function crearBoton(texto, comando, valor = null){

    let boton = document.createElement("button");

    // Muy importante:
    // evitamos que los botones de la barra
    // envíen el formulario
    boton.type = "button";

    boton.innerHTML = texto;
    const nombresFormato = {
      bold: "negrita",
      italic: "cursiva",
      underline: "subrayado",
      strikeThrough: "tachado",
      formatBlock: "bloque " + valor,
      insertUnorderedList: "lista con viñetas",
      insertOrderedList: "lista numerada",
      justifyLeft: "alinear a la izquierda",
      justifyCenter: "centrar",
      justifyRight: "alinear a la derecha",
      undo: "deshacer",
      redo: "rehacer"
    };
    boton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Aplicar " + nombresFormato[comando]);

    barra.appendChild(boton);

    boton.onclick = function(){

      document.execCommand(
        comando,
        false,
        valor
      );

      contenedor_rico.focus();

      actualizarHTML();

    };

    return boton;

  }


  // ==============================
  // BOTONES
  // ==============================

  crearBoton("<b>B</b>", "bold");

  crearBoton("<i>I</i>", "italic");

  crearBoton("<u>U</u>", "underline");

  crearBoton("<s>S</s>", "strikeThrough");

  crearBoton("H1", "formatBlock", "h1");

  crearBoton("H2", "formatBlock", "h2");

  crearBoton("P", "formatBlock", "p");

  crearBoton("•", "insertUnorderedList");

  crearBoton("1.", "insertOrderedList");

  crearBoton("←", "justifyLeft");

  crearBoton("↔", "justifyCenter");

  crearBoton("→", "justifyRight");

  crearBoton("↶", "undo");

  crearBoton("↷", "redo");


  // ==============================
  // BOTÓN ENLACE
  // ==============================

  let boton_enlace = document.createElement("button");

  boton_enlace.type = "button";

  boton_enlace.textContent = "🔗";
  boton_enlace.setAttribute("aria-label", "Insertar enlace");

  barra.appendChild(boton_enlace);

  boton_enlace.onclick = function(){

    let url = prompt("Introduce la URL:");

    if(url){

      document.execCommand(
        "createLink",
        false,
        url
      );

    }

    actualizarHTML();

  };


  // ==============================
  // QUITAR FORMATO
  // ==============================

  let boton_limpiar = document.createElement("button");

  boton_limpiar.type = "button";

  boton_limpiar.textContent = "Tx";
  boton_limpiar.setAttribute("aria-label", "Quitar formato");

  barra.appendChild(boton_limpiar);

  boton_limpiar.onclick = function(){

    document.execCommand(
      "removeFormat",
      false,
      null
    );

    actualizarHTML();

  };


  // ==============================
  // EDITOR VISUAL
  // ==============================

  let contenedor_rico = document.createElement("article");

  contenedor_rico.setAttribute(
    "contenteditable",
    "true"
  );
  contenedor_rico.setAttribute("role", "textbox");
  contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-label", "Editor de texto");
  contenedor_rico.setAttribute("aria-multiline", "true");

  contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_rico);


  // ==============================
  // TEXTAREA HTML
  // ==============================

  let contenedor_pobre = document.createElement("textarea");
  contenedor_pobre.setAttribute("aria-label", "Código HTML del texto");


  // ==============================
  // HEREDAR NAME
  // ==============================

  if(nombre){

    contenedor_pobre.setAttribute(
      "name",
      nombre
    );

  }


  contenedor.appendChild(contenedor_pobre);

  contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none";


  // ==============================
  // SINCRONIZACIÓN
  // ==============================

  function actualizarHTML(){

    contenedor_pobre.value =
      contenedor_rico.innerHTML;

  }


  contenedor_rico.oninput = function(){

    actualizarHTML();

  };


  // Si modificamos directamente
  // el código HTML del textarea,
  // actualizamos también el editor visual

  contenedor_pobre.oninput = function(){

    contenedor_rico.innerHTML =
      contenedor_pobre.value;

  };


  // ==============================
  // MOSTRAR / OCULTAR HTML
  // ==============================

  let boton_html = document.createElement("button");

  boton_html.type = "button";

  boton_html.textContent = "</>";
  boton_html.setAttribute("aria-label", "Mostrar u ocultar código HTML");

  barra.appendChild(boton_html);

  boton_html.onclick = function(){

    if(contenedor_pobre.style.display == "none"){

      actualizarHTML();

      contenedor_pobre.style.display = "block";

      contenedor_rico.style.display = "none";

    }else{

      contenedor_rico.innerHTML =
        contenedor_pobre.value;

      contenedor_pobre.style.display = "none";

      contenedor_rico.style.display = "block";

    }

  };

});
```

### 002-Propiedades, atributos y métodos
**000-Introducción.md**
```markdown
# Propiedades, atributos y métodos
* Propiedades y atributos comunes

  * `id`
  * `class`
  * `name`
  * `title`
  * `style`
  * `hidden`
  * `disabled`
  * `readonly`
  * `required`
  * `value`
  * `placeholder`
  * `tabindex`
  * `data-*`
  * `aria-*`

* Campo de texto: `<input type="text">`

  * Atributos

    * `value`
    * `placeholder`
    * `maxlength`
    * `minlength`
    * `required`
    * `readonly`
    * `disabled`
  * Propiedades JavaScript

    * `.value`
    * `.disabled`
    * `.readOnly`
    * `.selectionStart`
    * `.selectionEnd`
  * Métodos

    * `.focus()`
    * `.blur()`
    * `.select()`
    * `.setSelectionRange()`

* Área de texto: `<textarea>`

  * Atributos

    * `rows`
    * `cols`
    * `maxlength`
    * `placeholder`
    * `required`
    * `readonly`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`
    * `.rows`
    * `.cols`
  * Métodos

    * `.focus()`
    * `.select()`

* Botón: `<button>`

  * Atributos

    * `type`
    * `disabled`
    * `name`
    * `value`
  * Propiedades

    * `.disabled`
    * `.value`
  * Métodos

    * `.click()`
    * `.focus()`

* Casilla de verificación: `<input type="checkbox">`

  * Atributos

    * `checked`
    * `disabled`
    * `value`
  * Propiedades

    * `.checked`
    * `.indeterminate`
    * `.value`
  * Métodos

    * `.click()`

* Botón de opción: `<input type="radio">`

  * Atributos

    * `name`
    * `value`
    * `checked`
  * Propiedades

    * `.checked`
    * `.value`
  * Métodos

    * `.click()`

* Lista desplegable: `<select>`

  * Atributos

    * `multiple`
    * `size`
    * `required`
    * `disabled`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`
    * `.selectedIndex`
    * `.options`
  * Métodos

    * `.focus()`

* Opción: `<option>`

  * Atributos

    * `value`
    * `selected`
    * `disabled`
  * Propiedades

    * `.selected`
    * `.value`
    * `.text`

* Slider: `<input type="range">`

  * Atributos

    * `min`
    * `max`
    * `step`
    * `value`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`
    * `.valueAsNumber`

* Campo numérico: `<input type="number">`

  * Atributos

    * `min`
    * `max`
    * `step`
    * `value`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`
    * `.valueAsNumber`
  * Métodos

    * `.stepUp()`
    * `.stepDown()`

* Selector de fecha: `<input type="date">`

  * Atributos

    * `min`
    * `max`
    * `value`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`
    * `.valueAsDate`

* Selector de color: `<input type="color">`

  * Atributos

    * `value`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`

* Selector de archivos: `<input type="file">`

  * Atributos

    * `accept`
    * `multiple`
  * Propiedades

    * `.files`
    * `.multiple`

* Enlace: `<a>`

  * Atributos

    * `href`
    * `target`
    * `download`
    * `rel`
  * Propiedades

    * `.href`
    * `.target`
  * Métodos

    * `.click()`

* Imagen: `<img>`

  * Atributos

    * `src`
    * `alt`
    * `width`
    * `height`
    * `loading`
  * Propiedades

    * `.src`
    * `.naturalWidth`
    * `.naturalHeight`
    * `.complete`

* Barra de progreso: `<progress>`

  * Atributos

    * `value`
    * `max`
  * Propiedades

    * `.value`
    * `.max`

* Formulario: `<form>`

  * Atributos

    * `action`
    * `method`
    * `enctype`
    * `target`
  * Propiedades

    * `.elements`
    * `.action`
    * `.method`
  * Métodos

    * `.submit()`
    * `.reset()`
    * `.checkValidity()`
    * `.reportValidity()`

* Elementos genéricos: `<div>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, etc.

  * Propiedades

    * `.innerHTML`
    * `.textContent`
    * `.className`
```

```js
/* jocarsa-ui.js - Jocarsa Components Library */
(function(){
  "use strict";

  class JocarsaControl {
    static estilosInstalados = false;

    constructor(elemento, tipo){
      this.elemento = elemento;
      this.tipo = tipo;
      this.name = elemento.getAttribute("name") || "";
      this.value = elemento.getAttribute("value") || elemento.textContent.trim() || "";
      this.placeholder = elemento.getAttribute("placeholder") || "";
      this.required = elemento.hasAttribute("required");
      this.disabled = elemento.hasAttribute("disabled");
      this.instalarEstilos();

      this.raiz = document.createElement("div");
      this.raiz.className = `jocarsa-control jocarsa-${tipo}`;
      elemento.after(this.raiz);
      elemento.remove();
    }

    instalarEstilos(){
      if(JocarsaControl.estilosInstalados) return;
      JocarsaControl.estilosInstalados = true;
      const style = document.createElement("style");
      style.textContent = `
        .jocarsa-control{width:100%;max-width:720px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-sizing:border-box;margin:8px 0}
        .jocarsa-barra{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px;background:#eee;border-bottom:1px solid #aaa}
        .jocarsa-barra button{min-width:32px;height:30px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:3px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
        .jocarsa-barra button:hover{background:#ddd}.jocarsa-barra button.activo{background:#333;color:#fff}
        .jocarsa-area{min-height:240px;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;overflow:auto}
        .jocarsa-codigo,.jocarsa-markdown textarea,.jocarsa-texto textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:240px;padding:12px;border:0;outline:none;resize:vertical;box-sizing:border-box;font:14px/1.5 monospace;tab-size:2}
        .jocarsa-markdown .jocarsa-preview{min-height:240px;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;overflow:auto}
        .jocarsa-editor .jocarsa-codigo{margin:0;background:#181818;color:#eee;white-space:pre;overflow:auto}
        .jocarsa-editor textarea.jocarsa-hidden-input,.jocarsa-hidden-input{display:none!important}
        .jocarsa-firma canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:260px;background:#fff;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
        .jocarsa-firma .jocarsa-firma-info{padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;color:#666;border-top:1px solid #ddd}
      `;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }

    barra(){
      const barra = document.createElement("div");
      barra.className = "jocarsa-barra";
      this.raiz.appendChild(barra);
      return barra;
    }

    boton(barra, texto, fn, titulo=""){
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.innerHTML = texto;
      b.title = titulo;
      b.addEventListener("click", fn);
      barra.appendChild(b);
      return b;
    }

    campoOculto(tipo="textarea"){
      const campo = document.createElement(tipo);
      campo.className = "jocarsa-hidden-input";
      if(this.name) campo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) campo.required = true;
      if(this.disabled) campo.disabled = true;
      campo.value = this.value;
      this.raiz.appendChild(campo);
      this.campo = campo;
      return campo;
    }

    setValue(valor){
      this.value = valor;
      if(this.campo) this.campo.value = valor;
      this.raiz.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("jocarsa-change", {detail:{value:valor}}));
    }
  }

  class JocarsaTexto extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"texto");
      const barra = this.barra();
      const editor = document.createElement("article");
      editor.className = "jocarsa-area";
      editor.contentEditable = !this.disabled;
      editor.innerHTML = this.value;
      if(this.placeholder) editor.dataset.placeholder = this.placeholder;
      this.raiz.appendChild(editor);

      const codigo = document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.style.display = "none";
      codigo.value = this.value;
      if(this.name) codigo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) codigo.required = true;
      this.raiz.appendChild(codigo);
      this.campo = codigo;

      const cmd=(t,c,v=null)=>this.boton(barra,t,()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand(c,false,v);sync();});
      cmd("<b>B</b>","bold"); cmd("<i>I</i>","italic"); cmd("<u>U</u>","underline");
      cmd("H1","formatBlock","h1"); cmd("H2","formatBlock","h2"); cmd("P","formatBlock","p");
      cmd("•","insertUnorderedList"); cmd("1.","insertOrderedList");
      cmd("←","justifyLeft"); cmd("↔","justifyCenter"); cmd("→","justifyRight");
      cmd("↶","undo"); cmd("↷","redo");
      this.boton(barra,"🔗",()=>{const u=prompt("Introduce la URL:");if(u){editor.focus();document.execCommand("createLink",false,u);sync();}});
      this.boton(barra,"Tx",()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand("removeFormat",false,null);sync();});
      this.boton(barra,"&lt;/&gt;",()=>{
        const verCodigo = codigo.style.display === "none";
        if(verCodigo){sync(); editor.style.display="none"; codigo.style.display="block";}
        else{editor.innerHTML=codigo.value; editor.style.display="block"; codigo.style.display="none"; sync();}
      },"Ver HTML");

      const sync=()=>this.setValue(editor.innerHTML);
      editor.addEventListener("input",sync);
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>{this.value=codigo.value;});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaMarkdown extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"markdown");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const preview=document.createElement("div");
      preview.className="jocarsa-preview";
      preview.contentEditable=!this.disabled;
      const codigo=document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.value=this.value;
      if(this.name) codigo.name=this.name;
      if(this.required) codigo.required=true;
      codigo.style.display="none";
      this.raiz.append(preview,codigo);
      this.campo=codigo;

      const escapar=s=>s.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
      const render=md=>{
        let h=escapar(md);
        h=h.replace(/^### (.*)$/gm,"<h3>$1</h3>").replace(/^## (.*)$/gm,"<h2>$1</h2>").replace(/^# (.*)$/gm,"<h1>$1</h1>");
        h=h.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,"<strong>$1</strong>").replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g,"<em>$1</em>").replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,"<code>$1</code>");
        h=h.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2">$1</a>');
        h=h.replace(/^[-*] (.*)$/gm,"<li>$1</li>");
        h=h.replace(/(?:<li>.*<\/li>\n?)+/g,m=>"<ul>"+m+"</ul>");
        return h.split(/\n{2,}/).map(x=>/^<(h\d|ul|ol|blockquote)/.test(x)?x:`<p>${x.replace(/\n/g,"<br>")}</p>`).join("");
      };
      const htmlAMarkdown=()=>{
        let h=preview.innerHTML;
        h=h.replace(/<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/gi,"# $1\n\n").replace(/<h2[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h2>/gi,"## $1\n\n").replace(/<h3[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h3>/gi,"### $1\n\n");
        h=h.replace(/<(strong|b)[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi,"**$2**").replace(/<(em|i)[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi,"*$2*");
        h=h.replace(/<a[^>]*href=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*>(.*?)<\/a>/gi,"[$2]($1)");
        h=h.replace(/<li[^>]*>(.*?)<\/li>/gi,"- $1\n").replace(/<br\s*\/?\s*>/gi,"\n").replace(/<\/p>/gi,"\n\n").replace(/<p[^>]*>/gi,"");
        const tmp=document.createElement("div"); tmp.innerHTML=h; return tmp.textContent.replace(/\n{3,}/g,"\n\n").trim();
      };
      const syncPreview=()=>{codigo.value=htmlAMarkdown();this.value=codigo.value;};
      const envolver=(a,b=a)=>{const s=codigo.selectionStart,e=codigo.selectionEnd,t=codigo.value;codigo.value=t.slice(0,s)+a+t.slice(s,e)+b+t.slice(e);codigo.focus();codigo.selectionStart=s+a.length;codigo.selectionEnd=e+a.length;this.setValue(codigo.value);};
      this.boton(barra,"<b>B</b>",()=>envolver("**")); this.boton(barra,"<i>I</i>",()=>envolver("*"));
      this.boton(barra,"H1",()=>envolver("# ","")); this.boton(barra,"H2",()=>envolver("## ",""));
      this.boton(barra,"🔗",()=>{const u=prompt("Introduce la URL:");if(u) envolver("[","]("+u+")");});
      this.boton(barra,"MD",()=>{
        if(codigo.style.display==="none"){syncPreview();preview.style.display="none";codigo.style.display="block";}
        else{this.setValue(codigo.value);preview.innerHTML=render(codigo.value);codigo.style.display="none";preview.style.display="block";}
      },"Código Markdown / WYSIWYG");
      preview.innerHTML=render(this.value);
      preview.addEventListener("input",syncPreview);
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>{this.value=codigo.value;});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaEditor extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"editor");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const lenguaje=elemento.getAttribute("language")||elemento.getAttribute("lenguaje")||"texto";
      const etiqueta=document.createElement("span"); etiqueta.textContent=lenguaje; etiqueta.style.marginRight="auto"; etiqueta.style.padding="6px"; barra.appendChild(etiqueta);
      const codigo=document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.className="jocarsa-codigo"; codigo.spellcheck=false; codigo.value=this.value; codigo.placeholder=this.placeholder;
      if(this.name) codigo.name=this.name; if(this.required) codigo.required=true; if(this.disabled) codigo.disabled=true;
      this.raiz.appendChild(codigo); this.campo=codigo;
      this.boton(barra,"Copiar",()=>navigator.clipboard?.writeText(codigo.value));
      codigo.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Tab"){e.preventDefault();const s=codigo.selectionStart,en=codigo.selectionEnd;codigo.setRangeText("  ",s,en,"end");}});
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>this.setValue(codigo.value));
    }
  }

  class JocarsaFirma extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"firma");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");
      const info=document.createElement("div"); info.className="jocarsa-firma-info"; info.textContent="Firma dentro del recuadro";
      this.raiz.append(canvas,info);
      const campo=this.campoOculto("textarea");
      const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"); let dibujando=false, ultimo=null;
      const ajustar=()=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),d=window.devicePixelRatio||1;canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*d);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*d);ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.lineJoin="round";};
      ajustar();
      const punto=e=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),p=e.touches?e.touches[0]:e;return{x:p.clientX-r.left,y:p.clientY-r.top};};
      const inicio=e=>{e.preventDefault();dibujando=true;ultimo=punto(e);};
      const mover=e=>{if(!dibujando)return;e.preventDefault();const p=punto(e);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ultimo.x,ultimo.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();ultimo=p;};
      const fin=()=>{if(!dibujando)return;dibujando=false;this.setValue(canvas.toDataURL("image/png"));};
      canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",inicio); canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",mover); window.addEventListener("pointerup",fin);
      this.boton(barra,"Limpiar",()=>{ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);this.setValue("");});
    }
  }

  class Jocarsa {
    static controles={
      "jocarsa-texto":JocarsaTexto,
      "jocarsa-markdown":JocarsaMarkdown,
      "jocarsa-editor":JocarsaEditor,
      "jocarsa-firma":JocarsaFirma
    };
    static iniciar(){
      Object.entries(this.controles).forEach(([selector,Clase])=>document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el=>new Clase(el)));
    }
  }

  window.Jocarsa=Jocarsa;
  window.JocarsaControl=JocarsaControl;
  if(document.readyState==="loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>Jocarsa.iniciar()); else Jocarsa.iniciar();
})();
```

```js
        .jocarsa-firma canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:260px;background:var(--blanco);touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
        .jocarsa-firma .jocarsa-firma-info{padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid #d5deed;color:#475569;font-size:12px}
        .jocarsa-tabla{max-width:100%}.jocarsa-tabla-controles{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px;background:#f3f6fb;border-bottom:1px solid #d5deed}.jocarsa-tabla-controles input{flex:1;min-width:min(180px,100%);padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px}.jocarsa-tabla-controles select{min-height:36px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro)}.jocarsa-tabla-scroll{overflow:auto}.jocarsa-tabla table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}.jocarsa-tabla th,.jocarsa-tabla td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}.jocarsa-tabla th{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}.jocarsa-tabla th:hover{background:#dbeafe}.jocarsa-tabla th[data-dir=asc]::after{content:" ▲"}.jocarsa-tabla th[data-dir=desc]::after{content:" ▼"}.jocarsa-tabla-pie{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 12px;color:#475569;font-size:13px}.jocarsa-tabla-paginacion{display:flex;gap:4px}.jocarsa-tabla-paginacion button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
        .jocarsa-arbol{max-width:100%;padding:12px}.jocarsa-arbol ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding-left:20px}.jocarsa-arbol>ul{padding-left:0}.jocarsa-arbol li{position:relative}.jocarsa-arbol-nodo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}.jocarsa-arbol-nodo:hover{background:#eff6ff}.jocarsa-arbol-nodo.seleccionado{background:#dbeafe;color:var(--azul)}.jocarsa-arbol-toggle{width:18px;text-align:center;font-family:monospace}.jocarsa-arbol li.cerrado>ul{display:none}.jocarsa-arbol-icono{width:18px;text-align:center}
        @media(max-width:600px){.jocarsa-control{margin:10px 0;border-radius:10px}.jocarsa-barra{gap:5px;padding:8px}.jocarsa-barra button,.jocarsa-tabla-paginacion button{min-height:38px}.jocarsa-area,.jocarsa-markdown .jocarsa-preview{min-height:200px;padding:12px}.jocarsa-codigo,.jocarsa-markdown textarea,.jocarsa-texto textarea{min-height:200px;padding:12px}.jocarsa-tabla th,.jocarsa-tabla td{padding:8px 10px}}
      `;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }

    barra(){
      const barra = document.createElement("div");
      barra.className = "jocarsa-barra";
      this.raiz.appendChild(barra);
      return barra;
    }

    boton(barra, texto, fn, titulo=""){
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.innerHTML = texto;
      b.title = titulo;
      b.addEventListener("click", fn);
      barra.appendChild(b);
      return b;
    }

    campoOculto(tipo="textarea"){
      const campo = document.createElement(tipo);
      campo.className = "jocarsa-hidden-input";
      if(this.name) campo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) campo.required = true;
      if(this.disabled) campo.disabled = true;
      campo.value = this.value;
      this.raiz.appendChild(campo);
      this.campo = campo;
      return campo;
    }

    setValue(valor){
      this.value = valor;
      if(this.campo) this.campo.value = valor;
      this.raiz.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("jocarsa-change", {detail:{value:valor}}));
    }
  }

  class JocarsaTexto extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"texto");
      const barra = this.barra();
      const editor = document.createElement("article");
      editor.className = "jocarsa-area";
      editor.contentEditable = !this.disabled;
      editor.innerHTML = this.value;
      if(this.placeholder) editor.dataset.placeholder = this.placeholder;
      this.raiz.appendChild(editor);

      const codigo = document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.style.display = "none";
      codigo.value = this.value;
      if(this.name) codigo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) codigo.required = true;
      this.raiz.appendChild(codigo);
      this.campo = codigo;

      const cmd=(t,c,v=null)=>this.boton(barra,t,()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand(c,false,v);sync();});
      cmd("<b>B</b>","bold"); cmd("<i>I</i>","italic"); cmd("<u>U</u>","underline");
      cmd("H1","formatBlock","h1"); cmd("H2","formatBlock","h2"); cmd("P","formatBlock","p");
      cmd("•","insertUnorderedList"); cmd("1.","insertOrderedList");
      cmd("←","justifyLeft"); cmd("↔","justifyCenter"); cmd("→","justifyRight");
      cmd("↶","undo"); cmd("↷","redo");
      this.boton(barra,"🔗",()=>{const u=prompt("Introduce la URL:");if(u){editor.focus();document.execCommand("createLink",false,u);sync();}});
      this.boton(barra,"Tx",()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand("removeFormat",false,null);sync();});
      this.boton(barra,"&lt;/&gt;",()=>{
        const verCodigo = codigo.style.display === "none";
        if(verCodigo){sync(); editor.style.display="none"; codigo.style.display="block";}
        else{editor.innerHTML=codigo.value; editor.style.display="block"; codigo.style.display="none"; sync();}
      },"Ver HTML");

      const sync=()=>this.setValue(editor.innerHTML);
      editor.addEventListener("input",sync);
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>{this.value=codigo.value;});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaMarkdown extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"markdown");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const preview=document.createElement("div");
      preview.className="jocarsa-preview";
      preview.contentEditable=!this.disabled;
      const codigo=document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.value=this.value;
      if(this.name) codigo.name=this.name;
      if(this.required) codigo.required=true;
      codigo.style.display="none";
      this.raiz.append(preview,codigo);
      this.campo=codigo;

      const escapar=s=>s.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
      const render=md=>{
        let h=escapar(md);
        h=h.replace(/^### (.*)$/gm,"<h3>$1</h3>").replace(/^## (.*)$/gm,"<h2>$1</h2>").replace(/^# (.*)$/gm,"<h1>$1</h1>");
        h=h.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,"<strong>$1</strong>").replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g,"<em>$1</em>").replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,"<code>$1</code>");
        h=h.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2">$1</a>');
        h=h.replace(/^[-*] (.*)$/gm,"<li>$1</li>");
        h=h.replace(/(?:<li>.*<\/li>\n?)+/g,m=>"<ul>"+m+"</ul>");
        return h.split(/\n{2,}/).map(x=>/^<(h\d|ul|ol|blockquote)/.test(x)?x:`<p>${x.replace(/\n/g,"<br>")}</p>`).join("");
      };
      const htmlAMarkdown=()=>{
        let h=preview.innerHTML;
        h=h.replace(/<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/gi,"# $1\n\n").replace(/<h2[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h2>/gi,"## $1\n\n").replace(/<h3[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h3>/gi,"### $1\n\n");
        h=h.replace(/<(strong|b)[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi,"**$2**").replace(/<(em|i)[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi,"*$2*");
        h=h.replace(/<a[^>]*href=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*>(.*?)<\/a>/gi,"[$2]($1)");
        h=h.replace(/<li[^>]*>(.*?)<\/li>/gi,"- $1\n").replace(/<br\s*\/?\s*>/gi,"\n").replace(/<\/p>/gi,"\n\n").replace(/<p[^>]*>/gi,"");
        const tmp=document.createElement("div"); tmp.innerHTML=h; return tmp.textContent.replace(/\n{3,}/g,"\n\n").trim();
      };
      const syncPreview=()=>{codigo.value=htmlAMarkdown();this.value=codigo.value;};
      const envolver=(a,b=a)=>{const s=codigo.selectionStart,e=codigo.selectionEnd,t=codigo.value;codigo.value=t.slice(0,s)+a+t.slice(s,e)+b+t.slice(e);codigo.focus();codigo.selectionStart=s+a.length;codigo.selectionEnd=e+a.length;this.setValue(codigo.value);};
      this.boton(barra,"<b>B</b>",()=>envolver("**")); this.boton(barra,"<i>I</i>",()=>envolver("*"));
      this.boton(barra,"H1",()=>envolver("# ","")); this.boton(barra,"H2",()=>envolver("## ",""));
      this.boton(barra,"🔗",()=>{const u=prompt("Introduce la URL:");if(u) envolver("[","]("+u+")");});
      this.boton(barra,"MD",()=>{
        if(codigo.style.display==="none"){syncPreview();preview.style.display="none";codigo.style.display="block";}
        else{this.setValue(codigo.value);preview.innerHTML=render(codigo.value);codigo.style.display="none";preview.style.display="block";}
      },"Código Markdown / WYSIWYG");
      preview.innerHTML=render(this.value);
      preview.addEventListener("input",syncPreview);
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>{this.value=codigo.value;});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaEditor extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"editor");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const lenguaje=elemento.getAttribute("language")||elemento.getAttribute("lenguaje")||"texto";
      const etiqueta=document.createElement("span"); etiqueta.textContent=lenguaje; etiqueta.style.marginRight="auto"; etiqueta.style.padding="6px"; barra.appendChild(etiqueta);
      const codigo=document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.className="jocarsa-codigo"; codigo.spellcheck=false; codigo.value=this.value; codigo.placeholder=this.placeholder;
      if(this.name) codigo.name=this.name; if(this.required) codigo.required=true; if(this.disabled) codigo.disabled=true;
      this.raiz.appendChild(codigo); this.campo=codigo;
      this.boton(barra,"Copiar",()=>navigator.clipboard?.writeText(codigo.value));
      codigo.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Tab"){e.preventDefault();const s=codigo.selectionStart,en=codigo.selectionEnd;codigo.setRangeText("  ",s,en,"end");}});
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>this.setValue(codigo.value));
    }
  }

  class JocarsaFirma extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"firma");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");
      const info=document.createElement("div"); info.className="jocarsa-firma-info"; info.textContent="Firma dentro del recuadro";
      this.raiz.append(canvas,info);
      const campo=this.campoOculto("textarea");
      const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"); let dibujando=false, ultimo=null;
      const ajustar=()=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),d=window.devicePixelRatio||1;canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*d);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*d);ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.lineJoin="round";};
      ajustar();
      const punto=e=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),p=e.touches?e.touches[0]:e;return{x:p.clientX-r.left,y:p.clientY-r.top};};
      const inicio=e=>{e.preventDefault();dibujando=true;ultimo=punto(e);};
      const mover=e=>{if(!dibujando)return;e.preventDefault();const p=punto(e);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ultimo.x,ultimo.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();ultimo=p;};
      const fin=()=>{if(!dibujando)return;dibujando=false;this.setValue(canvas.toDataURL("image/png"));};
      canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown",inicio); canvas.addEventListener("pointermove",mover); window.addEventListener("pointerup",fin);
      this.boton(barra,"Limpiar",()=>{ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);this.setValue("");});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaTabla extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      const tablaOriginal=elemento.querySelector("table");
      const html=tablaOriginal ? tablaOriginal.outerHTML : elemento.innerHTML;
      super(elemento,"tabla");
      this.raiz.innerHTML=html;
      const tabla=this.raiz.querySelector("table");
      if(!tabla) return;
      const filas=[...tabla.tBodies].flatMap(tb=>[...tb.rows]);
      const controles=document.createElement("div"); controles.className="jocarsa-tabla-controles";
      const buscar=document.createElement("input"); buscar.type="search"; buscar.placeholder="Buscar...";
      const etiqueta=document.createElement("span"); etiqueta.textContent="Filas:";
      const cantidad=document.createElement("select"); [5,10,25,50,100].forEach(n=>{const o=document.createElement("option");o.value=n;o.textContent=n;if(n===10)o.selected=true;cantidad.appendChild(o)});
      controles.append(buscar,etiqueta,cantidad); this.raiz.insertBefore(controles,tabla);
      const scroll=document.createElement("div"); scroll.className="jocarsa-tabla-scroll"; tabla.before(scroll); scroll.appendChild(tabla);
      const pie=document.createElement("div"); pie.className="jocarsa-tabla-pie"; const info=document.createElement("span"), pag=document.createElement("div"); pag.className="jocarsa-tabla-paginacion"; pie.append(info,pag); this.raiz.appendChild(pie);
      let pagina=1,orden=-1,direccion=1;
      const valor=v=>{const t=v.trim().replace(",",".");return t!==""&&!isNaN(t)?Number(t):v.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("es")};
      const pintar=()=>{
        let visibles=filas.filter(f=>f.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase("es").includes(buscar.value.toLocaleLowerCase("es")));
        if(orden>=0) visibles.sort((a,b)=>{let x=valor(a.cells[orden]?.textContent||""),y=valor(b.cells[orden]?.textContent||"");return (x<y?-1:x>y?1:0)*direccion});
        filas.forEach(f=>f.style.display="none"); const por=Number(cantidad.value), total=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(visibles.length/por)); pagina=Math.min(pagina,total); const ini=(pagina-1)*por; visibles.slice(ini,ini+por).forEach(f=>f.style.display="");
        info.textContent=`Mostrando ${visibles.length?ini+1:0}-${Math.min(ini+por,visibles.length)} de ${visibles.length}`; pag.innerHTML="";
        const mk=(txt,fn,dis=false)=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.textContent=txt;b.disabled=dis;b.onclick=fn;pag.appendChild(b)}; mk("‹",()=>{pagina--;pintar()},pagina<=1); const n=document.createElement("span");n.style.padding="5px";n.textContent=`${pagina} / ${total}`;pag.appendChild(n);mk("›",()=>{pagina++;pintar()},pagina>=total);
      };
      tabla.querySelectorAll("thead th").forEach((th,i)=>th.addEventListener("click",()=>{tabla.querySelectorAll("thead th").forEach(x=>delete x.dataset.dir);if(orden===i)direccion*=-1;else{orden=i;direccion=1}th.dataset.dir=direccion===1?"asc":"desc";pagina=1;pintar()}));
      buscar.addEventListener("input",()=>{pagina=1;pintar()}); cantidad.addEventListener("change",()=>{pagina=1;pintar()}); pintar();
    }
  }

  class JocarsaArbol extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      const html=elemento.innerHTML; super(elemento,"arbol"); this.raiz.innerHTML=html;
      this.raiz.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li=>{
        const hijos=[...li.children]; const sub=hijos.find(x=>x.tagName==="UL"); const textos=[...li.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3).map(n=>n.textContent).join(" ").trim();
        [...li.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3).forEach(n=>n.remove());
        const nodo=document.createElement("div");nodo.className="jocarsa-arbol-nodo"; const toggle=document.createElement("span");toggle.className="jocarsa-arbol-toggle";toggle.textContent=sub?"▼":""; const icon=document.createElement("span");icon.className="jocarsa-arbol-icono";icon.textContent=sub?"📁":"📄"; const label=document.createElement("span");label.textContent=textos||li.getAttribute("data-label")||"Nodo"; nodo.append(toggle,icon,label);li.insertBefore(nodo,li.firstChild);
        if(sub){toggle.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();li.classList.toggle("cerrado");toggle.textContent=li.classList.contains("cerrado")?"▶":"▼";icon.textContent=li.classList.contains("cerrado")?"📁":"📂"}}
        nodo.onclick=()=>{this.raiz.querySelectorAll(".jocarsa-arbol-nodo").forEach(n=>n.classList.remove("seleccionado"));nodo.classList.add("seleccionado");this.setValue(label.textContent)};
      });
      if(this.name)this.campoOculto("input");
    }
  }

  class Jocarsa {
    static controles={
      "jocarsa-texto":JocarsaTexto,
      "jocarsa-markdown":JocarsaMarkdown,
      "jocarsa-editor":JocarsaEditor,
      "jocarsa-firma":JocarsaFirma,
      "jocarsa-tabla":JocarsaTabla,
      "jocarsa-arbol":JocarsaArbol
    };
    static iniciar(){
      Object.entries(this.controles).forEach(([selector,Clase])=>document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el=>new Clase(el)));
    }
  }

  window.Jocarsa=Jocarsa;
  window.JocarsaControl=JocarsaControl;
  if(document.readyState==="loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>Jocarsa.iniciar()); else Jocarsa.iniciar();
})();
```

```js
(function(){

  class JocarsaControl {
    static estilosInstalados = false;

      elemento.after(this.raiz);
```
