**andrei-componentes.css**
```css
/* ============================================================
   JOCARSA COMPONENTES
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes{
  margin:10px;
  font-family:Arial, sans-serif;
}

.jocarsa-componentes label{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}


/* ============================================================
   CONTROL GENERAL
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .control{
  display:flex;
  align-items:stretch;

  margin:5px 0;

  min-height:40px;
}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo{
  flex:1;

  min-width:0;
  min-height:20px;

  padding:10px;

  outline:none;

  border:1px solid grey;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  transition:
    border-color 0.2s,
    box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.jocarsa-componentes .campo:focus{
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}


/* ============================================================
   INDICADOR DERECHO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{
  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  width:32px;
  min-width:32px;

  padding:0 4px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  font-family:monospace;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:bold;

  user-select:none;
}


/* ============================================================
   VALIDACIÓN
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{
  border:2px solid green;
  padding:9px;
}

.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{
  border:2px solid red;
  padding:9px;
}


/* ============================================================
   PASSWORD
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{

  width:36px;
  min-width:36px;

  position:relative;

  padding:0;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;
}


/* Ojo exterior */

.jocarsa-componentes .icono-ojo{

  position:absolute;

  width:18px;
  height:11px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%)
    rotate(0deg);

  border:2px solid #555;

  border-radius:
    70% 30%
    70% 30%;

  box-sizing:border-box;
}


/* Pupila */

.jocarsa-componentes .icono-ojo::after{

  content:"";

  position:absolute;

  width:4px;
  height:4px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#555;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.ojo-password:hover{

  background:#eee;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.ojo-password.activo{

  background:#ddd;
}


/* ============================================================
   CHECKBOX -> SWITCH
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .switch{

  position:relative;

  width:48px;
  height:26px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  border-radius:20px;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  transition:
    background 0.25s;
}


.jocarsa-componentes .switch span{

  position:absolute;

  width:20px;
  height:20px;

  left:2px;
  top:2px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:grey;

  transition:
    left 0.25s,
    background 0.25s;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo{

  background:#ddd;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo span{

  left:24px;

  background:#222;
}


/* ============================================================
   RADIO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa{

  width:26px;
  height:26px;

  position:relative;

  border:2px solid grey;

  border-radius:50%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa span{

  position:absolute;

  width:0;
  height:0;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#333;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  transition:
    width 0.2s,
    height 0.2s;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa.activo span{

  width:14px;
  height:14px;
}


/* ============================================================
   TEXTAREA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.campo-textarea{

  min-height:120px;

  white-space:pre-wrap;

  overflow:auto;
}


/* ============================================================
   BUTTON
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa{

  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  padding:10px 20px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  cursor:pointer;

  user-select:none;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  transition:
    background 0.15s,
    transform 0.1s;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa:hover{

  background:#eee;
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa:active{

  background:#ddd;

  transform:
    translateY(1px);
}


.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa:focus{

  outline:2px solid grey;

  outline-offset:2px;
}

:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--fondo:#f3f6fb;--borde:#d5deed}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);background:var(--fondo);color:var(--negro);font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif}
body>h1,body>.introduccion,body>form,body>details,body>dialog,body>button,body>h2,body>p[contenteditable]{width:min(100%,920px);margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
body>h1{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.4rem);line-height:1.2}
.introduccion{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:24px;color:#475569}
form{padding:clamp(16px,4vw,32px);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-top:6px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:18px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 16px 44px #11182714}
h2{margin:30px 0 10px;padding-left:12px;border-left:4px solid var(--naranja);color:var(--azul);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.3}
label{display:block;margin:10px 0 5px;color:var(--negro);font-weight:700}
.jocarsa-componentes{margin:10px 0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
.jocarsa-componentes label{display:block;margin:0 0 6px}
.jocarsa-componentes .control{display:flex;align-items:stretch;min-height:44px;margin:5px 0;border-radius:9px}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;outline:none;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px 0 0 9px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:15px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo:focus{position:relative;z-index:1;border-color:var(--azul);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1d4ed833}
.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:42px;padding:0 7px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-left:0;border-radius:0 9px 9px 0;background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul);font:700 11px Consolas,monospace;user-select:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{border-color:var(--azul);background:#eff6ff}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{border-color:var(--naranja);background:#fff7ed}
.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{min-width:42px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-left:0;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--azul);cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password.activo{background:#eff6ff}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch{position:relative;width:48px;height:28px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:999px;background:#e2e8f0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch span{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #11182744;transition:left .15s,background .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch.activo{background:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch.activo span{left:23px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa{position:relative;width:26px;height:26px;border:2px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blanco);cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa span{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--naranja);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .15s,height .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa.activo span{width:14px;height:14px}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo-textarea{min-height:120px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow:auto}
.jocarsa-componentes .boton-jocarsa,.jocarsa-componentes button{min-height:42px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--azul);border-radius:8px;background:var(--azul);color:var(--blanco);font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .boton-jocarsa:hover,.jocarsa-componentes button:hover{background:#1e40af}
.jocarsa-componentes .clickable{box-shadow:0 3px 0 #11182724}
.jocarsa-componentes .focusable:focus,.jocarsa-componentes .clickable:focus,.jocarsa-componentes [contenteditable=true]:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;outline-offset:2px}
form>textarea,form>select,form>input:not([type=hidden]){display:block;width:100%;max-width:720px;min-height:44px;margin:5px 0 14px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:15px Arial,sans-serif}
form>textarea:focus,form>select:focus,form>input:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;border-color:var(--azul)}
form>textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}
form button,body>button{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--naranja);color:var(--blanco);font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
form button:hover,body>button:hover{background:#ea580c}
details{margin-top:20px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:10px;background:var(--blanco)}
summary{color:var(--azul);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
body>p[contenteditable=true]{min-height:60px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco)}
dialog{max-width:min(90vw,480px);padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px #11182733}
dialog::backdrop{background:#11182788}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-flecha{border-color:#cbd5e1;background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 12px 30px #11182720}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion{border-color:#e2e8f0;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-grupo{background:#dbeafe;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .salida-jocarsa{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--negro)}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:999px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa-relleno{background:var(--azul)}
@media(max-width:600px){body{padding:12px}form{padding:18px 14px;border-radius:14px}h2{margin-top:24px}.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{min-width:38px;padding:0 5px}}

**andrei-componentes.js**
```js
// ============================================================
// JOCARSA COMPONENTES
// ============================================================

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // UTILIDADES
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function crearContenedor(elemento){

    let contenedor = document.createElement("div")
    contenedor.classList.add("jocarsa-componentes")

    let anterior = elemento.previousElementSibling

    elemento.after(contenedor)

    // Si hay un label justo antes, lo movemos al componente
    if(anterior && anterior.tagName === "LABEL"){
      contenedor.appendChild(anterior)
    }

    return contenedor
  }


  function crearControl(){
    let control = document.createElement("div")
    control.classList.add("control")
    return control
  }


  function crearCampo(valor = ""){
    let campo = document.createElement("div")
    campo.classList.add("campo")
    campo.setAttribute("contenteditable", "true")
    campo.textContent = valor
    return campo
  }


  function crearTipo(texto){
    let tipo = document.createElement("span")
    tipo.classList.add("tipo-input")
    tipo.textContent = texto
    return tipo
  }


  function estadoNeutro(campo){
    campo.classList.remove("valido")
    campo.classList.remove("invalido")
  }


  function estadoValido(campo){
    campo.classList.add("valido")
    campo.classList.remove("invalido")
  }


  function estadoInvalido(campo){
    campo.classList.add("invalido")
    campo.classList.remove("valido")
  }


  // ==========================================================
  // INPUTS
  // ==========================================================

  let entradas = document.querySelectorAll("input")

  entradas.forEach(function(entrada){

    let tipoOriginal = entrada.type
    let valorOriginal = entrada.value

    let contenedor = crearContenedor(entrada)
    let control = crearControl()

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CHECKBOX
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if(tipoOriginal === "checkbox"){

      let switchControl = document.createElement("div")
      switchControl.classList.add("switch")

      let circulo = document.createElement("span")
      switchControl.appendChild(circulo)

      if(entrada.checked){
        switchControl.classList.add("activo")
      }

      switchControl.onclick = function(){
        switchControl.classList.toggle("activo")
      }

      control.appendChild(switchControl)

      contenedor.appendChild(control)

      entrada.remove()

      return
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // RADIO
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if(tipoOriginal === "radio"){

      let radio = document.createElement("div")
      radio.classList.add("radio-jocarsa")

      let interior = document.createElement("span")
      radio.appendChild(interior)

      if(entrada.checked){
        radio.classList.add("activo")
      }

      radio.onclick = function(){

        // Desactivamos radios hermanos
        let radios = document.querySelectorAll(".radio-jocarsa")

        radios.forEach(function(r){
          r.classList.remove("activo")
        })

        radio.classList.add("activo")
      }

      control.appendChild(radio)

      contenedor.appendChild(control)

      entrada.remove()

      return
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // RESTO DE INPUTS
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    let campo = crearCampo(valorOriginal)

    let tipos = {
      text: "T",
      number: "1",
      password: "*",
      email: "@",
      tel: "TEL",
      url: "URL",
      search: "?",
      date: "D",
      time: "H",
      "datetime-local": "DT",
      month: "M",
      week: "W",
      color: "RGB",
      range: "-",
      file: "F",
      hidden: "H"
    }

    let tipo = crearTipo(
      tipos[tipoOriginal] || "?"
    )


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // EMAIL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if(tipoOriginal === "email"){

      function validarEmail(){

        let valor = campo.textContent.trim()

        if(valor === ""){
          estadoNeutro(campo)
          return
        }

        let expresion =
          /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

        if(expresion.test(valor)){
          estadoValido(campo)
        }else{
          estadoInvalido(campo)
        }
      }

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        validarEmail
      )

      validarEmail()
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // URL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if(tipoOriginal === "url"){

      function validarURL(){

        let valor = campo.textContent.trim()

        if(valor === ""){
          estadoNeutro(campo)
          return
        }

        try{

          let url = new URL(valor)

          if(
            url.protocol === "http:" ||
            url.protocol === "https:"
          ){
            estadoValido(campo)
          }else{
            estadoInvalido(campo)
          }

        }catch(error){
          estadoInvalido(campo)
        }
      }

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        validarURL
      )

      validarURL()
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // NUMBER
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if(tipoOriginal === "number"){

      function validarNumero(){

        let valor = campo.textContent.trim()

        if(valor === ""){
          estadoNeutro(campo)
          return
        }

        if(
          valor !== "" &&
          !isNaN(valor) &&
          isFinite(valor)
        ){
          estadoValido(campo)
        }else{
          estadoInvalido(campo)
        }
      }

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        validarNumero
      )

      validarNumero()
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // PASSWORD
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if(tipoOriginal === "password"){

      let valorReal = valorOriginal
      let visible = false

      campo.textContent =
        "*".repeat(valorReal.length)

      let ojo = document.createElement("button")
      ojo.type = "button"
      ojo.classList.add("ojo-password")

      /*
        Icono de ojo dibujado con CSS.
        Sin emoji.
      */

      let iconoOjo = document.createElement("span")
      iconoOjo.classList.add("icono-ojo")

      ojo.appendChild(iconoOjo)

      ojo.onclick = function(){

        visible = !visible

        if(visible){

          campo.textContent = valorReal
          ojo.classList.add("activo")

        }else{

          valorReal = campo.textContent

          campo.textContent =
            "*".repeat(valorReal.length)

          ojo.classList.remove("activo")
        }
      }

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          if(visible){
            valorReal = campo.textContent
          }

        }
      )

      control.appendChild(campo)
      control.appendChild(ojo)
      control.appendChild(tipo)

    }else{

      control.appendChild(campo)
      control.appendChild(tipo)

    }

    contenedor.appendChild(control)

    entrada.remove()
  })


  // ==========================================================
  // TEXTAREA
  // ==========================================================

  let textareas =
    document.querySelectorAll("textarea")

  textareas.forEach(function(textarea){

    let valor = textarea.value

    let contenedor =
      crearContenedor(textarea)

    let control =
      crearControl()

    let campo =
      crearCampo(valor)

    campo.classList.add(
      "campo-textarea"
    )

    let tipo =
      crearTipo("TXT")

    control.appendChild(campo)
    control.appendChild(tipo)

    contenedor.appendChild(control)

    textarea.remove()
  })


  // ==========================================================
  // BUTTON
  // ==========================================================

  let botones =
    document.querySelectorAll("button")

  botones.forEach(function(boton){

    /*
      No transformamos botones internos
      creados por este mismo script.
    */

    if(
      boton.classList.contains(
        "ojo-password"
      )
    ){
      return
    }

    let contenedor =
      crearContenedor(boton)

    contenedor.classList.add(
      "contenedor-boton"
    )

    let nuevoBoton =
      document.createElement("div")

    nuevoBoton.classList.add(
      "boton-jocarsa"
    )

    nuevoBoton.setAttribute(
      "role",
      "button"
    )

    nuevoBoton.setAttribute(
      "tabindex",
      "0"
    )

    nuevoBoton.textContent =
      boton.textContent

    contenedor.appendChild(
      nuevoBoton
    )

    boton.remove()
  })

})
```

**andrei-componentes.css**
```css
/* ============================================================
   BASE
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes{
  margin:10px;
  font-family:Arial, sans-serif;
}

.jocarsa-componentes label{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}


/* ============================================================
   CONTROL
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .control{
  display:flex;
  align-items:stretch;

  margin:5px 0;

  min-height:40px;
}


/* ============================================================
   LENGUAJE DE INTERACCIÓN
   ============================================================ */

/* FOCUSABLE = hundido */

.jocarsa-componentes .focusable{

  box-shadow:
    4px 4px 0px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3)
    inset;

}


/* CLICKABLE = elevado */

.jocarsa-componentes .clickable{

  box-shadow:
    4px 4px 0px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo{

  flex:1;

  min-width:0;
  min-height:20px;

  padding:10px;

  outline:none;

  border:1px solid grey;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  background:white;

  transition:
    border-color 0.2s,
    box-shadow 0.2s;

}


/* ============================================================
   CAJITA DEL TIPO - DERECHA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  width:32px;
  min-width:32px;

  padding:0 4px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  font-family:monospace;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:bold;

  background:#eee;

  user-select:none;

}


/* ============================================================
   VALIDACIÓN
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{

  border:2px solid green;

  padding:9px;

}


.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{

  border:2px solid red;

  padding:9px;

}


/* ============================================================
   PASSWORD
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{

  position:relative;

  width:36px;
  min-width:36px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;

  box-sizing:border-box;

}


/* Forma exterior del ojo */

.jocarsa-componentes .icono-ojo{

  position:absolute;

  width:18px;
  height:11px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border:2px solid #555;

  border-radius:
    70% 30%
    70% 30%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

}


/* Pupila */

.jocarsa-componentes
.icono-ojo::after{

  content:"";

  position:absolute;

  width:4px;
  height:4px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#555;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.ojo-password:hover{

  background:#eee;

}


/* ============================================================
   CHECKBOX -> SWITCH
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .switch{

  position:relative;

  width:48px;
  height:26px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  border-radius:20px;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  background:white;

  transition:
    background 0.25s,
    box-shadow 0.1s,
    transform 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch span{

  position:absolute;

  width:20px;
  height:20px;

  left:2px;
  top:2px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:grey;

  transition:
    left 0.25s,
    background 0.25s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo{

  background:#ddd;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo span{

  left:24px;

  background:#222;

}


/* ============================================================
   RADIO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa{

  position:relative;

  width:26px;
  height:26px;

  border:2px solid grey;

  border-radius:50%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  background:white;

  transition:
    box-shadow 0.1s,
    transform 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa span{

  position:absolute;

  width:0;
  height:0;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#333;

  transition:
    width 0.2s,
    height 0.2s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa.activo span{

  width:14px;
  height:14px;

}


/* ============================================================
   TEXTAREA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.campo-textarea{

  min-height:120px;

  white-space:pre-wrap;

  overflow:auto;

}


/* ============================================================
   BOTONES
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa{

  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  padding:10px 20px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;

  user-select:none;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  transition:
    background 0.15s,
    transform 0.1s,
    box-shadow 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa:hover{

  background:#eee;

}


/*
  Al hacer click el elemento
  se hunde ligeramente.
*/

.jocarsa-componentes
.clickable:active{

  transform:
    translate(2px,2px);

  box-shadow:
    2px 2px 0px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

}


/* ============================================================
   FOCUS
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.clickable:focus{

  outline:1px solid #555;

  outline-offset:3px;

}

:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--fondo:#f3f6fb;--borde:#d5deed}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);background:var(--fondo);color:var(--negro);font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif}
body>h1,body>.introduccion,body>form,body>details,body>dialog,body>button,body>h2,body>p[contenteditable]{width:min(100%,920px);margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
body>h1{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.4rem);line-height:1.2}
.introduccion{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:24px;color:#475569}
form{padding:clamp(16px,4vw,32px);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-top:6px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:18px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 16px 44px #11182714}
h2{margin:30px 0 10px;padding-left:12px;border-left:4px solid var(--naranja);color:var(--azul);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.3}
label{display:block;margin:10px 0 5px;color:var(--negro);font-weight:700}
.jocarsa-componentes{margin:10px 0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
.jocarsa-componentes label{display:block;margin:0 0 6px}
.jocarsa-componentes .control{display:flex;align-items:stretch;min-height:44px;margin:5px 0;border-radius:9px}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;outline:none;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px 0 0 9px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:15px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo:focus{position:relative;z-index:1;border-color:var(--azul);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1d4ed833}
.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:42px;padding:0 7px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-left:0;border-radius:0 9px 9px 0;background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul);font:700 11px Consolas,monospace;user-select:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{border-color:var(--azul);background:#eff6ff}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{border-color:var(--naranja);background:#fff7ed}
.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{min-width:42px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-left:0;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--azul);cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password.activo{background:#eff6ff}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch{position:relative;width:48px;height:28px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:999px;background:#e2e8f0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch span{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #11182744;transition:left .15s,background .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch.activo{background:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch.activo span{left:23px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa{position:relative;width:26px;height:26px;border:2px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blanco);cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa span{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--naranja);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .15s,height .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa.activo span{width:14px;height:14px}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo-textarea{min-height:120px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow:auto}
.jocarsa-componentes .boton-jocarsa,.jocarsa-componentes button{min-height:42px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--azul);border-radius:8px;background:var(--azul);color:var(--blanco);font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .boton-jocarsa:hover,.jocarsa-componentes button:hover{background:#1e40af}
.jocarsa-componentes .clickable{box-shadow:0 3px 0 #11182724}
.jocarsa-componentes .focusable:focus,.jocarsa-componentes .clickable:focus,.jocarsa-componentes [contenteditable=true]:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;outline-offset:2px}
form>textarea,form>select,form>input:not([type=hidden]){display:block;width:100%;max-width:720px;min-height:44px;margin:5px 0 14px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:15px Arial,sans-serif}
form>textarea:focus,form>select:focus,form>input:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;border-color:var(--azul)}
form>textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}
form button,body>button{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--naranja);color:var(--blanco);font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
form button:hover,body>button:hover{background:#ea580c}
details{margin-top:20px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:10px;background:var(--blanco)}
summary{color:var(--azul);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
body>p[contenteditable=true]{min-height:60px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco)}
dialog{max-width:min(90vw,480px);padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px #11182733}
dialog::backdrop{background:#11182788}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-flecha{border-color:#cbd5e1;background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 12px 30px #11182720}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion{border-color:#e2e8f0;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-grupo{background:#dbeafe;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .salida-jocarsa{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--negro)}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:999px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa-relleno{background:var(--azul)}
@media(max-width:600px){body{padding:12px}form{padding:18px 14px;border-radius:14px}h2{margin-top:24px}.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{min-width:38px;padding:0 5px}}

**andrei-componentes.js**
```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){

  // ============================================================
  // CONFIGURACIÓN / UTILIDADES
  // ============================================================

  const TIPOS = {
    text: "T",
    number: "1",
    password: "*",
    email: "@",
    tel: "TEL",
    url: "URL",
    search: "?",
    date: "D",
    time: "H",
    "datetime-local": "DT",
    month: "M",
    week: "W",
    color: "RGB",
    range: "-",
    file: "F"
  }


  function crearContenedor(elemento){

    let contenedor = document.createElement("div")

    contenedor.classList.add(
      "jocarsa-componentes"
    )

    /*
      Guardamos información del control original
    */

    contenedor.dataset.name =
      elemento.name || ""

    contenedor.dataset.id =
      elemento.id || ""

    contenedor.dataset.required =
      elemento.required ? "true" : "false"


    /*
      Insertamos el nuevo componente justo
      después del elemento original.
    */

    elemento.after(contenedor)


    /*
      Si justo antes había un LABEL,
      lo movemos dentro del componente.
    */

    let anterior =
      elemento.previousElementSibling

    if(
      anterior &&
      anterior.tagName === "LABEL"
    ){

      contenedor.appendChild(
        anterior
      )

    }


    return contenedor
  }


  function crearControl(){

    let control =
      document.createElement("div")

    control.classList.add(
      "control"
    )

    return control
  }


  function crearCampo(valor = ""){

    let campo =
      document.createElement("div")

    campo.classList.add(
      "campo",
      "focusable"
    )

    campo.setAttribute(
      "contenteditable",
      "true"
    )

    campo.setAttribute(
      "tabindex",
      "0"
    )

    campo.textContent =
      valor

    return campo
  }


  function crearTipo(texto){

    let tipo =
      document.createElement("span")

    tipo.classList.add(
      "tipo-input"
    )

    tipo.textContent =
      texto

    return tipo
  }


  function estadoNeutro(campo){

    campo.classList.remove(
      "valido",
      "invalido"
    )
  }


  function estadoValido(campo){

    campo.classList.add(
      "valido"
    )

    campo.classList.remove(
      "invalido"
    )
  }


  function estadoInvalido(campo){

    campo.classList.add(
      "invalido"
    )

    campo.classList.remove(
      "valido"
    )
  }


  // ============================================================
  // VALIDADORES
  // ============================================================

  function validarEmail(valor){

    let expresion =
      /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

    return expresion.test(valor)
  }


  function validarURL(valor){

    try{

      let url =
        new URL(valor)

      return (
        url.protocol === "http:" ||
        url.protocol === "https:"
      )

    }catch(error){

      return false
    }
  }


  function validarNumero(valor){

    if(valor.trim() === ""){
      return false
    }

    return (
      !isNaN(valor) &&
      isFinite(valor)
    )
  }


  // ============================================================
  // VALIDAR FORMULARIO JOCARSA
  // ============================================================

  function validarFormulario(formulario){

    let correcto = true

    let componentes =
      formulario.querySelectorAll(
        ".jocarsa-componentes[data-name]"
      )


    componentes.forEach(
      function(componente){

        let requerido =
          componente.dataset.required === "true"

        let tipo =
          componente.dataset.tipo

        let valor =
          componente.dataset.valor || ""


        // REQUIRED

        if(requerido){

          if(
            tipo === "checkbox" ||
            tipo === "radio"
          ){

            if(
              componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
            ){

              correcto = false

            }

          }else{

            if(valor.trim() === ""){

              correcto = false

              let campo =
                componente.querySelector(
                  ".campo"
                )

              if(campo){

                estadoInvalido(
                  campo
                )

              }

            }

          }

        }


        // EMAIL

        if(
          tipo === "email" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarEmail(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }


        // URL

        if(
          tipo === "url" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarURL(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }


        // NUMBER

        if(
          tipo === "number" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarNumero(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }

      }
    )


    return correcto
  }


  // ============================================================
  // ENVÍO POST
  // ============================================================

  function enviarFormularioJocarsa(
    formulario,
    botonSubmit = null
  ){

    if(
      !validarFormulario(
        formulario
      )
    ){

      console.warn(
        "Formulario no válido"
      )

      let primero =
        formulario.querySelector(
          ".campo.invalido"
        )

      if(primero){
        primero.focus()
      }

      return
    }


    /*
      Creamos un formulario temporal.
    */

    let formularioPost =
      document.createElement("form")


    formularioPost.method =
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaMethod ||
      "POST"


    formularioPost.action =
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaAction ||
      window.location.href


    /*
      Si había target, lo conservamos.
    */

    if(
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget
    ){

      formularioPost.target =
        formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget

    }


    /*
      Recorremos nuestros componentes.
    */

    let componentes =
      formulario.querySelectorAll(
        ".jocarsa-componentes[data-name]"
      )


    componentes.forEach(
      function(componente){

        let nombre =
          componente.dataset.name

        let tipo =
          componente.dataset.tipo

        let valor =
          componente.dataset.valor || ""


        /*
          Sin NAME no se envía.
        */

        if(!nombre){
          return
        }


        /*
          Checkbox desactivado:
          HTML normal tampoco lo envía.
        */

        if(
          tipo === "checkbox" &&
          componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
        ){
          return
        }


        /*
          Radio no seleccionado:
          tampoco se envía.
        */

        if(
          tipo === "radio" &&
          componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
        ){
          return
        }


        /*
          Creamos un input hidden temporal.
        */

        let hidden =
          document.createElement("input")

        hidden.type =
          "hidden"

        hidden.name =
          nombre

        hidden.value =
          valor


        formularioPost.appendChild(
          hidden
        )

      }
    )


    /*
      Si el submit tenía NAME/VALUE,
      también lo enviamos.
    */

    if(
      botonSubmit &&
      botonSubmit.dataset.name
    ){

      let hidden =
        document.createElement("input")

      hidden.type =
        "hidden"

      hidden.name =
        botonSubmit.dataset.name

      hidden.value =
        botonSubmit.dataset.valor || ""


      formularioPost.appendChild(
        hidden
      )

    }


    /*
      Añadimos temporalmente al DOM.
    */

    document.body.appendChild(
      formularioPost
    )


    /*
      POST real tradicional.
    */

    formularioPost.submit()

  }


  // ============================================================
  // PREPARAMOS LOS FORMULARIOS
  // ============================================================

  let formularios =
    document.querySelectorAll("form")


  formularios.forEach(
    function(formulario){

      /*
        Guardamos configuración original.
      */

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaAction =
        formulario.getAttribute("action") ||
        window.location.href

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaMethod =
        (
          formulario.getAttribute("method") ||
          "POST"
        ).toUpperCase()

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget =
        formulario.getAttribute("target") ||
        ""

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // INPUTS
  // ============================================================

  let entradas =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "input"
      )
    )


  entradas.forEach(
    function(entrada){

      let tipoOriginal =
        entrada.type.toLowerCase()

      let valorOriginal =
        entrada.value

      let formulario =
        entrada.closest("form")


      // ========================================================
      // HIDDEN
      // ========================================================

      /*
        Aunque visualmente no existe,
        debemos conservar su valor para POST.
      */

      if(tipoOriginal === "hidden"){

        if(formulario){

          let almacen =
            document.createElement("div")

          almacen.classList.add(
            "jocarsa-componentes",
            "jocarsa-hidden"
          )

          almacen.dataset.tipo =
            "hidden"

          almacen.dataset.name =
            entrada.name || ""

          almacen.dataset.valor =
            entrada.value || ""

          almacen.style.display =
            "none"


          entrada.after(
            almacen
          )

        }

        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // SUBMIT
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "submit"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "submit"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.value || "Enviar"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Enviar"


        function enviar(){

          if(formulario){

            enviarFormularioJocarsa(
              formulario,
              contenedor
            )

          }

        }


        boton.addEventListener(
          "click",
          enviar
        )


        boton.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === "Enter" ||
              event.key === " "
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              enviar()

            }

          }
        )


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // RESET
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "reset"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "reset"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Restablecer"


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // BUTTON
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "button"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "button"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Botón"


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // CHECKBOX
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "checkbox"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "checkbox"

        contenedor.dataset.checkboxValue =
          entrada.value || "on"

        contenedor.dataset.checked =
          entrada.checked
            ? "true"
            : "false"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.checked
            ? (
                entrada.value ||
                "on"
              )
            : ""


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let switchControl =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        switchControl.classList.add(
          "switch",
          "clickable"
        )

        switchControl.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        switchControl.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "checkbox"
        )


        let circulo =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        switchControl.appendChild(
          circulo
        )


        function actualizar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked ===
            "true"


          switchControl.classList.toggle(
            "activo",
            activo
          )

          switchControl.setAttribute(
            "aria-checked",
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"
          )


          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            activo
              ? contenedor.dataset.checkboxValue
              : ""

        }


        function cambiar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked !==
            "true"

          contenedor.dataset.checked =
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"

          actualizar()

        }


        switchControl.addEventListener(
          "click",
          cambiar
        )


        switchControl.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              cambiar()

            }

          }
        )


        actualizar()


        control.appendChild(
          switchControl
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // RADIO
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "radio"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "radio"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.value || "on"

        contenedor.dataset.checked =
          entrada.checked
            ? "true"
            : "false"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let radio =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        radio.classList.add(
          "radio-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        radio.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        radio.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "radio"
        )


        let interior =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        radio.appendChild(
          interior
        )


        function actualizar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked ===
            "true"


          radio.classList.toggle(
            "activo",
            activo
          )

          radio.setAttribute(
            "aria-checked",
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"
          )

        }


        function activar(){

          /*
            Desactivamos solamente radios
            con el MISMO NAME.
          */

          if(formulario){

            let radios =
              formulario.querySelectorAll(
                '.jocarsa-componentes[data-tipo="radio"]'
              )


            radios.forEach(
              function(otro){

                if(
                  otro.dataset.name ===
                  contenedor.dataset.name
                ){

                  otro.dataset.checked =
                    "false"

                  let visual =
                    otro.querySelector(
                      ".radio-jocarsa"
                    )

                  if(visual){

                    visual.classList.remove(
                      "activo"
                    )

                    visual.setAttribute(
                      "aria-checked",
                      "false"
                    )

                  }

                }

              }
            )

          }


          contenedor.dataset.checked =
            "true"

          actualizar()

        }


        radio.addEventListener(
          "click",
          activar
        )


        radio.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              activar()

            }

          }
        )


        actualizar()


        control.appendChild(
          radio
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // INPUT NORMAL
      // ========================================================

      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          entrada
        )

      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        tipoOriginal

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        valorOriginal


      /*
        Conservamos restricciones interesantes.
      */

      if(entrada.min !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.min =
          entrada.min
      }

      if(entrada.max !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.max =
          entrada.max
      }

      if(entrada.step !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.step =
          entrada.step
      }

      if(entrada.placeholder){

        contenedor.dataset.placeholder =
          entrada.placeholder

      }


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let campo =
        crearCampo(
          valorOriginal
        )


      let tipo =
        crearTipo(
          TIPOS[tipoOriginal] ||
          "?"
        )


      // ========================================================
      // SINCRONIZACIÓN
      // ========================================================

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          if(
            tipoOriginal !==
            "password"
          ){

            contenedor.dataset.valor =
              campo.textContent

          }

        }
      )


      // ========================================================
      // EMAIL
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "email"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

          }else if(
            validarEmail(valor)
          ){

            estadoValido(
              campo
            )

          }else{

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

          }

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // URL
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "url"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

          }else if(
            validarURL(valor)
          ){

            estadoValido(
              campo
            )

          }else{

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

          }

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // NUMBER
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "number"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          if(
            !validarNumero(valor)
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          let numero =
            Number(valor)


          if(
            contenedor.dataset.min !== undefined &&
            contenedor.dataset.min !== "" &&
            numero <
            Number(
              contenedor.dataset.min
            )
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          if(
            contenedor.dataset.max !== undefined &&
            contenedor.dataset.max !== "" &&
            numero >
            Number(
              contenedor.dataset.max
            )
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          estadoValido(
            campo
          )

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // PASSWORD
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "password"){

        let valorReal =
          valorOriginal

        let visible =
          false


        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          valorReal


        campo.textContent =
          "*".repeat(
            valorReal.length
          )


        let ojo =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        ojo.classList.add(
          "ojo-password",
          "clickable"
        )

        ojo.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        ojo.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )


        let icono =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        icono.classList.add(
          "icono-ojo"
        )

        ojo.appendChild(
          icono
        )


        function mostrarOcultar(){

          visible =
            !visible


          if(visible){

            campo.textContent =
              valorReal

            ojo.classList.add(
              "activo"
            )

          }else{

            /*
              Si estaba visible,
              recogemos el valor editado.
            */

            valorReal =
              campo.textContent

            contenedor.dataset.valor =
              valorReal

            campo.textContent =
              "*".repeat(
                valorReal.length
              )

            ojo.classList.remove(
              "activo"
            )

          }

        }


        ojo.addEventListener(
          "click",
          mostrarOcultar
        )


        ojo.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              mostrarOcultar()

            }

          }
        )


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          function(){

            if(visible){

              valorReal =
                campo.textContent

              contenedor.dataset.valor =
                valorReal

            }

          }
        )


        control.appendChild(
          campo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          ojo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          tipo
        )

      }else{

        control.appendChild(
          campo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          tipo
        )

      }


      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      /*
        AHORA SÍ:
        destruimos completamente
        el input original.
      */

      entrada.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // TEXTAREA
  // ============================================================

  let textareas =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "textarea"
      )
    )


  textareas.forEach(
    function(textarea){

      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          textarea
        )


      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        "textarea"

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        textarea.value


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let campo =
        crearCampo(
          textarea.value
        )


      campo.classList.add(
        "campo-textarea"
      )


      let tipo =
        crearTipo("TXT")


      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            campo.textContent

        }
      )


      control.appendChild(
        campo
      )

      control.appendChild(
        tipo
      )


      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      textarea.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // BUTTON NATIVO
  // ============================================================

  let botones =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "button"
      )
    )


  botones.forEach(
    function(botonOriginal){

      /*
        Ignoramos cualquier botón que ya
        pertenezca a nuestros componentes.
      */

      if(
        botonOriginal.closest(
          ".jocarsa-componentes"
        )
      ){
        return
      }


      let formulario =
        botonOriginal.closest(
          "form"
        )


      let tipoOriginal =
        (
          botonOriginal.type ||
          "submit"
        ).toLowerCase()


      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          botonOriginal
        )


      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        tipoOriginal

      contenedor.dataset.name =
        botonOriginal.name || ""

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        botonOriginal.value || ""


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let boton =
        document.createElement(
          "div"
        )


      boton.classList.add(
        "boton-jocarsa",
        "clickable"
      )


      boton.setAttribute(
        "role",
        "button"
      )

      boton.setAttribute(
        "tabindex",
        "0"
      )


      boton.innerHTML =
        botonOriginal.innerHTML


      function ejecutar(){

        if(
          tipoOriginal === "submit"
        ){

          if(formulario){

            enviarFormularioJocarsa(
              formulario,
              contenedor
            )

          }

        }else if(
          tipoOriginal === "reset"
        ){

          /*
            Podemos implementar después
            restauración completa de estados.
          */

          console.log(
            "Reset JOCARSA"
          )

        }

      }


      boton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        ejecutar
      )


      boton.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        function(event){

          if(
            event.key === " " ||
            event.key === "Enter"
          ){

            event.preventDefault()

            ejecutar()

          }

        }
      )


      control.appendChild(
        boton
      )

      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      botonOriginal.remove()

    }
  )

})
```
**procesa.php**

**andrei-componentes-ampliado.css**
```css
/* ============================================================
   BASE
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes{
  margin:10px;
  font-family:Arial, sans-serif;
}

.jocarsa-componentes label{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}


/* ============================================================
   CONTROL
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .control{
  display:flex;
  align-items:stretch;

  margin:5px 0;

  min-height:40px;
}


/* ============================================================
   LENGUAJE DE INTERACCIÓN
   ============================================================ */

/* FOCUSABLE = hundido */

.jocarsa-componentes .focusable{

  box-shadow:
    1px 1px 1px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3)
    inset;

}


/* CLICKABLE = elevado */

.jocarsa-componentes .clickable{

  box-shadow:
    1px 1px 1px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo{

  flex:1;

  min-width:0;
  min-height:20px;

  padding:10px;

  outline:none;

  border:1px solid grey;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  background:white;

  transition:
    border-color 0.2s,
    box-shadow 0.2s;

}


/* ============================================================
   CAJITA DEL TIPO - DERECHA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  width:32px;
  min-width:32px;

  padding:0 4px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  font-family:monospace;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:bold;

  background:#eee;

  user-select:none;

}


/* ============================================================
   VALIDACIÓN
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{

  border:2px solid green;

  padding:9px;

}


.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{

  border:2px solid red;

  padding:9px;

}


/* ============================================================
   PASSWORD
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{

  position:relative;

  width:36px;
  min-width:36px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;

  box-sizing:border-box;

}


/* Forma exterior del ojo */

.jocarsa-componentes .icono-ojo{

  position:absolute;

  width:18px;
  height:11px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border:2px solid #555;

  border-radius:
    70% 30%
    70% 30%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

}


/* Pupila */

.jocarsa-componentes
.icono-ojo::after{

  content:"";

  position:absolute;

  width:4px;
  height:4px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#555;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.ojo-password:hover{

  background:#eee;

}


/* ============================================================
   CHECKBOX -> SWITCH
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .switch{

  position:relative;

  width:48px;
  height:26px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  border-radius:20px;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  background:white;

  transition:
    background 0.25s,
    box-shadow 0.1s,
    transform 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch span{

  position:absolute;

  width:20px;
  height:20px;

  left:2px;
  top:2px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:grey;

  transition:
    left 0.25s,
    background 0.25s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo{

  background:#ddd;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo span{

  left:24px;

  background:#222;

}


/* ============================================================
   RADIO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa{

  position:relative;

  width:26px;
  height:26px;

  border:2px solid grey;

  border-radius:50%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  background:white;

  transition:
    box-shadow 0.1s,
    transform 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa span{

  position:absolute;

  width:0;
  height:0;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#333;

  transition:
    width 0.2s,
    height 0.2s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa.activo span{

  width:14px;
  height:14px;

}


/* ============================================================
   TEXTAREA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.campo-textarea{

  min-height:120px;

  white-space:pre-wrap;

  overflow:auto;

}


/* ============================================================
   BOTONES
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa{

  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  padding:10px 20px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;

  user-select:none;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  transition:
    background 0.15s,
    transform 0.1s,
    box-shadow 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa:hover{

  background:#eee;

}


/*
  Al hacer click el elemento
  se hunde ligeramente.
*/

.jocarsa-componentes
.clickable:active{

  transform:
    translate(2px,2px);

  box-shadow:
    2px 2px 0px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

}


/* ============================================================
   FOCUS
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.clickable:focus{

  outline:1px solid #555;

  outline-offset:3px;

}
/* ============================================================
   SELECT / COMBOBOX BUSCABLE
   ============================================================ */
.jocarsa-componentes .control-select{position:relative;overflow:visible}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-jocarsa{display:flex;flex:1;position:relative;min-width:0}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-campo{flex:1;padding-right:38px}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-flecha{width:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid grey;border-left:0;background:#eee;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;z-index:1000;max-height:240px;overflow:auto;background:white;border:1px solid grey;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista.abierta{display:block}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;background:white;cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada{background:#eee}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada::before{content:"✓ ";font-weight:bold}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-grupo{padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;background:#ddd;text-transform:uppercase;position:sticky;top:0}
.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa{flex:1;position:relative;border:1px solid grey;background:white;min-height:40px}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-buscador{padding:10px;min-height:20px;outline:none;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-buscador:empty::before{content:attr(data-placeholder);opacity:.45}
.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa .select-lista{position:relative;top:auto;left:auto;right:auto;border:0;box-shadow:none;max-height:180px}

/* OUTPUT / PROGRESS / METER */
.jocarsa-componentes .salida-jocarsa{background:#eee}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:40px;border:1px solid grey;background:white;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa-relleno{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:#ddd}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa span{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;font-size:12px}

:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--fondo:#f3f6fb;--borde:#d5deed}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:clamp(16px,5vw,48px);background:var(--fondo);color:var(--negro);font:16px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif}
body>h1,body>.introduccion,body>form,body>details,body>dialog,body>button,body>h2,body>p[contenteditable]{width:min(100%,920px);margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
body>h1{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.4rem);line-height:1.2}
.introduccion{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:24px;color:#475569}
form{padding:clamp(16px,4vw,32px);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-top:6px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:18px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 16px 44px #11182714}
h2{margin:30px 0 10px;padding-left:12px;border-left:4px solid var(--naranja);color:var(--azul);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.3}
label{display:block;margin:10px 0 5px;color:var(--negro);font-weight:700}
.jocarsa-componentes{margin:10px 0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
.jocarsa-componentes label{display:block;margin:0 0 6px}
.jocarsa-componentes .control{display:flex;align-items:stretch;min-height:44px;margin:5px 0;border-radius:9px}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;outline:none;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px 0 0 9px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:15px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo:focus{position:relative;z-index:1;border-color:var(--azul);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1d4ed833}
.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:42px;padding:0 7px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-left:0;border-radius:0 9px 9px 0;background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul);font:700 11px Consolas,monospace;user-select:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{border-color:var(--azul);background:#eff6ff}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{border-color:var(--naranja);background:#fff7ed}
.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{min-width:42px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-left:0;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--azul);cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password.activo{background:#eff6ff}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch{position:relative;width:48px;height:28px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:999px;background:#e2e8f0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch span{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #11182744;transition:left .15s,background .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch.activo{background:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .switch.activo span{left:23px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa{position:relative;width:26px;height:26px;border:2px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blanco);cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa span{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--naranja);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .15s,height .15s}
.jocarsa-componentes .radio-jocarsa.activo span{width:14px;height:14px}
.jocarsa-componentes .campo-textarea{min-height:120px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow:auto}
.jocarsa-componentes .boton-jocarsa,.jocarsa-componentes button{min-height:42px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--azul);border-radius:8px;background:var(--azul);color:var(--blanco);font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .boton-jocarsa:hover,.jocarsa-componentes button:hover{background:#1e40af}
.jocarsa-componentes .clickable{box-shadow:0 3px 0 #11182724}
.jocarsa-componentes .focusable:focus,.jocarsa-componentes .clickable:focus,.jocarsa-componentes [contenteditable=true]:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;outline-offset:2px}
form>textarea,form>select,form>input:not([type=hidden]){display:block;width:100%;max-width:720px;min-height:44px;margin:5px 0 14px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro);font:15px Arial,sans-serif}
form>textarea:focus,form>select:focus,form>input:focus{outline:3px solid #1d4ed833;border-color:var(--azul)}
form>textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}
form button,body>button{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--naranja);color:var(--blanco);font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
form button:hover,body>button:hover{background:#ea580c}
details{margin-top:20px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:10px;background:var(--blanco)}
summary{color:var(--azul);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
body>p[contenteditable=true]{min-height:60px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco)}
dialog{max-width:min(90vw,480px);padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-top:5px solid var(--naranja);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px #11182733}
dialog::backdrop{background:#11182788}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-flecha{border-color:#cbd5e1;background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco);box-shadow:0 12px 30px #11182720}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion{border-color:#e2e8f0;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-grupo{background:#dbeafe;color:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .salida-jocarsa{background:#eff6ff;color:var(--negro)}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa{border-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:999px;background:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa-relleno{background:var(--azul)}
@media(max-width:600px){body{padding:12px}form{padding:18px 14px;border-radius:14px}h2{margin-top:24px}.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{min-width:38px;padding:0 5px}}
