**andrei-componentes-ampliado.js**
```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){

  // ============================================================
  // CONFIGURACIÓN / UTILIDADES
  // ============================================================

  const TIPOS = {
    text: "T",
    number: "1",
    password: "*",
    email: "@",
    tel: "TEL",
    url: "URL",
    search: "?",
    date: "D",
    time: "H",
    "datetime-local": "DT",
    month: "M",
    week: "W",
    color: "RGB",
    range: "-",
    file: "F"
  }


  function crearContenedor(elemento){

    let contenedor = document.createElement("div")

    contenedor.classList.add(
      "jocarsa-componentes"
    )

    /*
      Guardamos información del control original
    */

    contenedor.dataset.name =
      elemento.name || ""

    contenedor.dataset.id =
      elemento.id || ""

    contenedor.dataset.required =
      elemento.required ? "true" : "false"


    /*
      Insertamos el nuevo componente justo
      después del elemento original.
    */

    elemento.after(contenedor)


    /*
      Si justo antes había un LABEL,
      lo movemos dentro del componente.
    */

    let anterior =
      elemento.previousElementSibling

    if(
      anterior &&
      anterior.tagName === "LABEL"
    ){

      contenedor.appendChild(
        anterior
      )

    }


    return contenedor
  }


  function crearControl(){

    let control =
      document.createElement("div")

    control.classList.add(
      "control"
    )

    return control
  }


  function crearCampo(valor = ""){

    let campo =
      document.createElement("div")

    campo.classList.add(
      "campo",
      "focusable"
    )

    campo.setAttribute(
      "contenteditable",
      "true"
    )

    campo.setAttribute(
      "tabindex",
      "0"
    )

    campo.textContent =
      valor

    return campo
  }


  function crearTipo(texto){

    let tipo =
      document.createElement("span")

    tipo.classList.add(
      "tipo-input"
    )

    tipo.textContent =
      texto

    return tipo
  }


  function estadoNeutro(campo){

    campo.classList.remove(
      "valido",
      "invalido"
    )
  }


  function estadoValido(campo){

    campo.classList.add(
      "valido"
    )

    campo.classList.remove(
      "invalido"
    )
  }


  function estadoInvalido(campo){

    campo.classList.add(
      "invalido"
    )

    campo.classList.remove(
      "valido"
    )
  }


  // ============================================================
  // VALIDADORES
  // ============================================================

  function validarEmail(valor){

    let expresion =
      /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

    return expresion.test(valor)
  }


  function validarURL(valor){

    try{

      let url =
        new URL(valor)

      return (
        url.protocol === "http:" ||
        url.protocol === "https:"
      )

    }catch(error){

      return false
    }
  }


  function validarNumero(valor){

    if(valor.trim() === ""){
      return false
    }

    return (
      !isNaN(valor) &&
      isFinite(valor)
    )
  }


  // ============================================================
  // VALIDAR FORMULARIO JOCARSA
  // ============================================================

  function validarFormulario(formulario){

    let correcto = true

    let componentes =
      formulario.querySelectorAll(
        ".jocarsa-componentes[data-name]"
      )


    componentes.forEach(
      function(componente){

        let requerido =
          componente.dataset.required === "true"

        let tipo =
          componente.dataset.tipo

        let valor =
          componente.dataset.valor || ""


        // REQUIRED

        if(requerido){

          if(
            tipo === "checkbox" ||
            tipo === "radio"
          ){

            if(
              componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
            ){

              correcto = false

            }

          }else{

            if(valor.trim() === ""){

              correcto = false

              let campo =
                componente.querySelector(
                  ".campo"
                )

              if(campo){

                estadoInvalido(
                  campo
                )

              }

            }

          }

        }


        // EMAIL

        if(
          tipo === "email" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarEmail(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }


        // URL

        if(
          tipo === "url" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarURL(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }


        // NUMBER

        if(
          tipo === "number" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarNumero(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }

      }
    )


    return correcto
  }


  // ============================================================
  // ENVÍO POST
  // ============================================================

  function enviarFormularioJocarsa(
    formulario,
    botonSubmit = null
  ){

    if(
      !validarFormulario(
        formulario
      )
    ){

      console.warn(
        "Formulario no válido"
      )

      let primero =
        formulario.querySelector(
          ".campo.invalido"
        )

      if(primero){
        primero.focus()
      }

      return
    }


    /*
      Creamos un formulario temporal.
    */

    let formularioPost =
      document.createElement("form")


    formularioPost.method =
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaMethod ||
      "POST"


    formularioPost.action =
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaAction ||
      window.location.href


    /*
      Si había target, lo conservamos.
    */

    if(
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget
    ){

      formularioPost.target =
        formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget

    }


    /*
      Recorremos nuestros componentes.
    */

    let componentes =
      formulario.querySelectorAll(
        ".jocarsa-componentes[data-name]"
      )


    componentes.forEach(
      function(componente){

        let nombre =
          componente.dataset.name

        let tipo =
          componente.dataset.tipo

        let valor =
          componente.dataset.valor || ""


        /*
          Sin NAME no se envía.
        */

        if(!nombre){
          return
        }


        /*
          Checkbox desactivado:
          HTML normal tampoco lo envía.
        */

        if(
          tipo === "checkbox" &&
          componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
        ){
          return
        }


        /*
          Radio no seleccionado:
          tampoco se envía.
        */

        if(
          tipo === "radio" &&
          componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
        ){
          return
        }


        /*
          Creamos un input hidden temporal.
        */

        let hidden =
          document.createElement("input")

        hidden.type =
          "hidden"

        hidden.name =
          nombre

        hidden.value =
          valor


        formularioPost.appendChild(
          hidden
        )

      }
    )


    /*
      Si el submit tenía NAME/VALUE,
      también lo enviamos.
    */

    if(
      botonSubmit &&
      botonSubmit.dataset.name
    ){

      let hidden =
        document.createElement("input")

      hidden.type =
        "hidden"

      hidden.name =
        botonSubmit.dataset.name

      hidden.value =
        botonSubmit.dataset.valor || ""


      formularioPost.appendChild(
        hidden
      )

    }


    /*
      Añadimos temporalmente al DOM.
    */

    document.body.appendChild(
      formularioPost
    )


    /*
      POST real tradicional.
    */

    formularioPost.submit()

  }


  // ============================================================
  // PREPARAMOS LOS FORMULARIOS
  // ============================================================

  let formularios =
    document.querySelectorAll("form")


  formularios.forEach(
    function(formulario){

      /*
        Guardamos configuración original.
      */

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaAction =
        formulario.getAttribute("action") ||
        window.location.href

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaMethod =
        (
          formulario.getAttribute("method") ||
          "POST"
        ).toUpperCase()

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget =
        formulario.getAttribute("target") ||
        ""

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // INPUTS
  // ============================================================

  let entradas =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "input"
      )
    )


  entradas.forEach(
    function(entrada){

      let tipoOriginal =
        entrada.type.toLowerCase()

      let valorOriginal =
        entrada.value

      let formulario =
        entrada.closest("form")


      // ========================================================
      // HIDDEN
      // ========================================================

      /*
        Aunque visualmente no existe,
        debemos conservar su valor para POST.
      */

      if(tipoOriginal === "hidden"){

        if(formulario){

          let almacen =
            document.createElement("div")

          almacen.classList.add(
            "jocarsa-componentes",
            "jocarsa-hidden"
          )

          almacen.dataset.tipo =
            "hidden"

          almacen.dataset.name =
            entrada.name || ""

          almacen.dataset.valor =
            entrada.value || ""

          almacen.style.display =
            "none"


          entrada.after(
            almacen
          )

        }

        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // SUBMIT
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "submit"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "submit"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.value || "Enviar"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Enviar"


        function enviar(){

          if(formulario){

            enviarFormularioJocarsa(
              formulario,
              contenedor
            )

          }

        }


        boton.addEventListener(
          "click",
          enviar
        )


        boton.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === "Enter" ||
              event.key === " "
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              enviar()

            }

          }
        )


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // RESET
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "reset"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "reset"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Restablecer"


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // BUTTON
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "button"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "button"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Botón"


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // CHECKBOX
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "checkbox"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "checkbox"

        contenedor.dataset.checkboxValue =
          entrada.value || "on"

        contenedor.dataset.checked =
          entrada.checked
            ? "true"
            : "false"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.checked
            ? (
                entrada.value ||
                "on"
              )
            : ""


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let switchControl =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        switchControl.classList.add(
          "switch",
          "clickable"
        )

        switchControl.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        switchControl.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "checkbox"
        )


        let circulo =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        switchControl.appendChild(
          circulo
        )


        function actualizar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked ===
            "true"


          switchControl.classList.toggle(
            "activo",
            activo
          )

          switchControl.setAttribute(
            "aria-checked",
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"
          )


          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            activo
              ? contenedor.dataset.checkboxValue
              : ""

        }


        function cambiar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked !==
            "true"

          contenedor.dataset.checked =
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"

          actualizar()

        }


        switchControl.addEventListener(
          "click",
          cambiar
        )


        switchControl.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              cambiar()

            }

          }
        )


        actualizar()


        control.appendChild(
          switchControl
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // RADIO
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "radio"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "radio"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.value || "on"

        contenedor.dataset.checked =
          entrada.checked
            ? "true"
            : "false"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let radio =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        radio.classList.add(
          "radio-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        radio.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        radio.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "radio"
        )


        let interior =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        radio.appendChild(
          interior
        )


        function actualizar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked ===
            "true"


          radio.classList.toggle(
            "activo",
            activo
          )

          radio.setAttribute(
            "aria-checked",
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"
          )

        }


        function activar(){

          /*
            Desactivamos solamente radios
            con el MISMO NAME.
          */

          if(formulario){

            let radios =
              formulario.querySelectorAll(
                '.jocarsa-componentes[data-tipo="radio"]'
              )


            radios.forEach(
              function(otro){

                if(
                  otro.dataset.name ===
                  contenedor.dataset.name
                ){

                  otro.dataset.checked =
                    "false"

                  let visual =
                    otro.querySelector(
                      ".radio-jocarsa"
                    )

                  if(visual){

                    visual.classList.remove(
                      "activo"
                    )

                    visual.setAttribute(
                      "aria-checked",
                      "false"
                    )

                  }

                }

              }
            )

          }


          contenedor.dataset.checked =
            "true"

          actualizar()

        }


        radio.addEventListener(
          "click",
          activar
        )


        radio.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              activar()

            }

          }
        )


        actualizar()


        control.appendChild(
          radio
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // INPUT NORMAL
      // ========================================================

      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          entrada
        )

      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        tipoOriginal

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        valorOriginal


      /*
        Conservamos restricciones interesantes.
      */

      if(entrada.min !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.min =
          entrada.min
      }

      if(entrada.max !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.max =
          entrada.max
      }

      if(entrada.step !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.step =
          entrada.step
      }

      if(entrada.placeholder){

        contenedor.dataset.placeholder =
          entrada.placeholder

      }


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let campo =
        crearCampo(
          valorOriginal
        )


      let tipo =
        crearTipo(
          TIPOS[tipoOriginal] ||
          "?"
        )


      // ========================================================
      // SINCRONIZACIÓN
      // ========================================================

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          if(
            tipoOriginal !==
            "password"
          ){

            contenedor.dataset.valor =
              campo.textContent

          }

        }
      )


      // ========================================================
      // EMAIL
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "email"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

          }else if(
            validarEmail(valor)
          ){

            estadoValido(
              campo
            )

          }else{

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

          }

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // URL
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "url"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

          }else if(
            validarURL(valor)
          ){

            estadoValido(
              campo
            )

          }else{

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

          }

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // NUMBER
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "number"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          if(
            !validarNumero(valor)
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          let numero =
            Number(valor)


          if(
            contenedor.dataset.min !== undefined &&
            contenedor.dataset.min !== "" &&
            numero <
            Number(
              contenedor.dataset.min
            )
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          if(
            contenedor.dataset.max !== undefined &&
            contenedor.dataset.max !== "" &&
            numero >
            Number(
              contenedor.dataset.max
            )
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          estadoValido(
            campo
          )

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // PASSWORD
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "password"){

        let valorReal =
          valorOriginal

        let visible =
          false


        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          valorReal


        campo.textContent =
          "*".repeat(
            valorReal.length
          )


        let ojo =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        ojo.classList.add(
          "ojo-password",
          "clickable"
        )

        ojo.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        ojo.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )


        let icono =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        icono.classList.add(
          "icono-ojo"
        )

        ojo.appendChild(
          icono
        )


        function mostrarOcultar(){

          visible =
            !visible


          if(visible){

            campo.textContent =
              valorReal

            ojo.classList.add(
              "activo"
            )

          }else{

            /*
              Si estaba visible,
              recogemos el valor editado.
            */

            valorReal =
              campo.textContent

            contenedor.dataset.valor =
              valorReal

            campo.textContent =
              "*".repeat(
                valorReal.length
              )

            ojo.classList.remove(
              "activo"
            )

          }

        }


        ojo.addEventListener(
          "click",
          mostrarOcultar
        )


        ojo.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              mostrarOcultar()

            }

          }
        )


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          function(){

            if(visible){

              valorReal =
                campo.textContent

              contenedor.dataset.valor =
                valorReal

            }

          }
        )


        control.appendChild(
          campo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          ojo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          tipo
        )

      }else{

        control.appendChild(
          campo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          tipo
        )

      }


      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      /*
        AHORA SÍ:
        destruimos completamente
        el input original.
      */

      entrada.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // TEXTAREA
  // ============================================================

  let textareas =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "textarea"
      )
    )


  textareas.forEach(
    function(textarea){

      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          textarea
        )


      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        "textarea"

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        textarea.value


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let campo =
        crearCampo(
          textarea.value
        )


      campo.classList.add(
        "campo-textarea"
      )


      let tipo =
        crearTipo("TXT")


      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            campo.textContent

        }
      )


      control.appendChild(
        campo
      )

      control.appendChild(
        tipo
      )


      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      textarea.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // BUTTON NATIVO
  // ============================================================

  let botones =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "button"
      )
    )


  botones.forEach(
    function(botonOriginal){

      /*
        Ignoramos cualquier botón que ya
        pertenezca a nuestros componentes.
      */

      if(
        botonOriginal.closest(
          ".jocarsa-componentes"
        )
      ){
        return
      }


      let formulario =
        botonOriginal.closest(
          "form"
        )


      let tipoOriginal =
        (
          botonOriginal.type ||
          "submit"
        ).toLowerCase()


      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          botonOriginal
        )


      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        tipoOriginal

      contenedor.dataset.name =
        botonOriginal.name || ""

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        botonOriginal.value || ""


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let boton =
        document.createElement(
          "div"
        )


      boton.classList.add(
        "boton-jocarsa",
        "clickable"
      )


      boton.setAttribute(
        "role",
        "button"
      )

      boton.setAttribute(
        "tabindex",
        "0"
      )


      boton.innerHTML =
        botonOriginal.innerHTML


      function ejecutar(){

        if(
          tipoOriginal === "submit"
        ){

          if(formulario){

            enviarFormularioJocarsa(
              formulario,
              contenedor
            )

          }

        }else if(
          tipoOriginal === "reset"
        ){

          /*
            Podemos implementar después
            restauración completa de estados.
          */

          console.log(
            "Reset JOCARSA"
          )

        }

      }


      boton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        ejecutar
      )


      boton.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        function(event){

          if(
            event.key === " " ||
            event.key === "Enter"
          ){

            event.preventDefault()

            ejecutar()

          }

        }
      )


      control.appendChild(
        boton
      )

      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      botonOriginal.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // SELECT -> COMBOBOX BUSCABLE / MULTISELECT
  // ============================================================
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("select")).forEach(function(selectOriginal){
    if(selectOriginal.closest(".jocarsa-componentes")) return

    const contenedor = crearContenedor(selectOriginal)
    contenedor.dataset.tipo = selectOriginal.multiple ? "select-multiple" : "select"
    contenedor.dataset.disabled = selectOriginal.disabled ? "true" : "false"

    const opciones = Array.from(selectOriginal.options).map(function(op){
      return {
        value: op.value,
        text: op.textContent,
        disabled: op.disabled,
        selected: op.selected,
        group: op.parentElement && op.parentElement.tagName === "OPTGROUP" ? op.parentElement.label : ""
      }
    })

    const control = crearControl()
    control.classList.add("control-select")

    if(selectOriginal.multiple){
      const caja = document.createElement("div")
      caja.className = "multiselect-jocarsa focusable"
      caja.tabIndex = selectOriginal.disabled ? -1 : 0
      const buscador = document.createElement("div")
      buscador.className = "select-buscador"
      buscador.contentEditable = selectOriginal.disabled ? "false" : "true"
      buscador.dataset.placeholder = "Buscar..."
      const lista = document.createElement("div")
      lista.className = "select-lista abierta"
      caja.append(buscador, lista)

      let seleccionados = opciones.filter(o=>o.selected && !o.disabled).map(o=>o.value)
      function pintar(filtro=""){
        lista.innerHTML=""
        opciones.filter(o=>o.text.toLowerCase().includes(filtro.toLowerCase())).forEach(function(o){
          const item=document.createElement("div")
          item.className="select-opcion clickable"+(seleccionados.includes(o.value)?" seleccionada":"")+(o.disabled?" disabled":"")
          item.textContent=(o.group ? o.group+" · " : "")+o.text
          if(!o.disabled && !selectOriginal.disabled) item.onclick=function(){
            seleccionados.includes(o.value) ? seleccionados=seleccionados.filter(v=>v!==o.value) : seleccionados.push(o.value)
            contenedor.dataset.valor=JSON.stringify(seleccionados)
            pintar(buscador.textContent.trim())
          }
          lista.appendChild(item)
        })
      }
      buscador.addEventListener("input",()=>pintar(buscador.textContent.trim()))
      contenedor.dataset.valor=JSON.stringify(seleccionados)
      contenedor.dataset.multiple="true"
      pintar()
      control.append(caja, crearTipo("SEL"))
    }else{
      const combo=document.createElement("div")
      combo.className="combo-jocarsa"
      const campo=crearCampo("")
      campo.classList.add("combo-campo")
      campo.contentEditable=selectOriginal.disabled ? "false" : "true"
      campo.tabIndex=selectOriginal.disabled ? -1 : 0
      const flecha=document.createElement("div")
      flecha.className="combo-flecha clickable"
      flecha.textContent="▾"
      const lista=document.createElement("div")
      lista.className="select-lista"
      combo.append(campo,flecha,lista)

      let elegida=opciones.find(o=>o.selected) || opciones[0] || null
      function elegir(o){
        elegida=o
        campo.textContent=o ? o.text : ""
        contenedor.dataset.valor=o ? o.value : ""
        lista.classList.remove("abierta")
      }
      function pintar(filtro=""){
        lista.innerHTML=""
        let grupoAnterior=null
        opciones.filter(o=>o.text.toLowerCase().includes(filtro.toLowerCase())).forEach(function(o){
          if(o.group && o.group!==grupoAnterior){
            const g=document.createElement("div"); g.className="select-grupo"; g.textContent=o.group; lista.appendChild(g); grupoAnterior=o.group
          }
          const item=document.createElement("div")
          item.className="select-opcion clickable"+(o.disabled?" disabled":"")
          item.textContent=o.text
          if(!o.disabled && !selectOriginal.disabled) item.addEventListener("mousedown",function(e){e.preventDefault(); elegir(o)})
          lista.appendChild(item)
        })
      }
      campo.addEventListener("focus",function(){ pintar(campo.textContent.trim()); lista.classList.add("abierta") })
      campo.addEventListener("input",function(){ contenedor.dataset.valor=""; pintar(campo.textContent.trim()); lista.classList.add("abierta") })
      campo.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){ if(e.key==="Escape") lista.classList.remove("abierta") })
      flecha.addEventListener("click",function(){ if(selectOriginal.disabled)return; pintar(""); lista.classList.toggle("abierta"); campo.focus() })
      document.addEventListener("mousedown",function(e){ if(!combo.contains(e.target)) lista.classList.remove("abierta") })
      elegir(elegida)
      control.append(combo,crearTipo("SEL"))
    }
    contenedor.appendChild(control)
    selectOriginal.remove()
  })

  // ============================================================
  // OUTPUT / PROGRESS / METER -> REPRESENTACIÓN JOCARSA
  // ============================================================
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("output, progress, meter")).forEach(function(original){
    if(original.closest(".jocarsa-componentes")) return
    const tag=original.tagName.toLowerCase()
    const contenedor=crearContenedor(original)
    contenedor.dataset.tipo=tag
    contenedor.dataset.name=original.getAttribute("name") || ""
    const control=crearControl()

    if(tag==="output"){
      const campo=document.createElement("div")
      campo.className="campo salida-jocarsa"
      campo.textContent=original.value || original.textContent
      contenedor.dataset.valor=campo.textContent
      control.append(campo,crearTipo("OUT"))
    }else{
      const min=tag==="meter" ? Number(original.min||0) : 0
      const max=Number(original.max||1)
      const value=Number(original.value||0)
      const pct=max>min ? Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(value-min)/(max-min)*100)) : 0
      const barra=document.createElement("div")
      barra.className="barra-jocarsa"
      const relleno=document.createElement("div")
      relleno.className="barra-jocarsa-relleno"
      relleno.style.width=pct+"%"
      const texto=document.createElement("span")
      texto.textContent=tag==="progress" && !original.hasAttribute("value") ? "…" : value+" / "+max
      barra.append(relleno,texto)
      control.append(barra,crearTipo(tag==="meter"?"MTR":"PRG"))
    }
    contenedor.appendChild(control)
    original.remove()
  })

})
```

### 004-Persistencia del componente
**000-Introducción.md**
```markdown
# Persistencia del componente
* Persistencia
	* Archivos
	* Bases de datos
	* Cookies
	* `localStorage`
	* `sessionStorage`
	* Preferencias
	* Archivos de configuración


```

```markdown
Sabemos que estamos trabajando en el cliente y en el servidor
Pero sabemos que los controles de interfaz están más cerca del cliente que del servidor
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html>

  </head>
  <body>
```
```html
    <input type="radio" name="temporada" value="año">Año<br>
```

```html
    <input type="radio" name="temporada" value="semana">Semana<br>
    <input type="radio" name="temporada" value="dia">Dia<br>
    <script>
      let entradas = document.querySelectorAll("input")
      entradas.forEach(function(entrada){
      	entrada.onchange = function(){
        	console.log("Has cambiado a:"+entrada.getAttribute("value"))
          localStorage.setItem(entrada.getAttribute("name"),entrada.getAttribute("value"))
        }
        if(
          localStorage.getItem(entrada.getAttribute("name")) != undefined
					&&
          localStorage.getItem(entrada.getAttribute("name")) == entrada.value
        ){
        	entrada.setAttribute("checked","true")
        }
      })
    </script>

</html>
```

```html

<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Botonera deslizante</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      padding: 30px;
    }

    .botonera {
      display: inline-flex;
      position: relative;
      background: #e9edf2;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 5px;
      gap: 0;
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .botonera button {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      min-width: 100px;
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: #64748b;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.3s;
    }

    .botonera button.activo {
      color: white;
    }

    .indicador {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 0;
      top: 5px;
      left: 5px;
      height: calc(100% - 10px);
      background: #475569;
      border-radius: 9px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px #0002;
      transition:
        transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
        width 0.35s ease;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="botonera">
    <div class="indicador"></div>
    <button data-valor="año">Año</button>
    <button data-valor="mes">Mes</button>
    <button data-valor="semana">Semana</button>
    <button data-valor="dia">Día</button>
  </div>

  <script>
    let botonera = document.querySelector(".botonera");
    let botones = botonera.querySelectorAll("button");
    let indicador = botonera.querySelector(".indicador");

    function seleccionar(boton) {
      botones.forEach(function(b) {
        b.classList.remove("activo");
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      });

      boton.classList.add("activo");
      boton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");

      indicador.style.width = boton.offsetWidth + "px";
      indicador.style.transform =
        "translateX(" + boton.offsetLeft + "px)";

      localStorage.setItem("temporada", boton.dataset.valor);
      console.log("Has cambiado a: " + boton.dataset.valor);
    }

    botones.forEach(function(boton) {
      boton.onclick = function() {
        seleccionar(boton);
      };
    });

    let guardado = localStorage.getItem("temporada") || "año";
    let inicial = Array.from(botones).find(function(boton) {
      return boton.dataset.valor === guardado;
    }) || botones[0];

    // Posicionar sin animación al cargar
    indicador.style.transition = "none";
    seleccionar(inicial);

    requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        indicador.style.transition = "";
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
      let activo = botonera.querySelector(".activo");
      if (activo) seleccionar(activo);
    });
  </script>

</body>
</html>

```

**andrei-componentes-ampliado.css**
```css
/* ============================================================
   BASE
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes{
  margin:10px;
  font-family:Arial, sans-serif;
}

.jocarsa-componentes label{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}


/* ============================================================
   CONTROL
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .control{
  display:flex;
  align-items:stretch;

  margin:5px 0;

  min-height:40px;
}


/* ============================================================
   LENGUAJE DE INTERACCIÓN
   ============================================================ */

/* FOCUSABLE = hundido */

.jocarsa-componentes .focusable{

  box-shadow:
    1px 1px 1px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3)
    inset;

}


/* CLICKABLE = elevado */

.jocarsa-componentes .clickable{

  box-shadow:
    1px 1px 1px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo{

  flex:1;

  min-width:0;
  min-height:20px;

  padding:10px;

  outline:none;

  border:1px solid grey;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  background:white;

  transition:
    border-color 0.2s,
    box-shadow 0.2s;

}


/* ============================================================
   CAJITA DEL TIPO - DERECHA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .tipo-input{

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  width:32px;
  min-width:32px;

  padding:0 4px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  font-family:monospace;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:bold;

  background:#eee;

  user-select:none;

}


/* ============================================================
   VALIDACIÓN
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .campo.valido{

  border:2px solid green;

  padding:9px;

}


.jocarsa-componentes .campo.invalido{

  border:2px solid red;

  padding:9px;

}


/* ============================================================
   PASSWORD
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .ojo-password{

  position:relative;

  width:36px;
  min-width:36px;

  border:1px solid grey;
  border-left:0;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;

  box-sizing:border-box;

}


/* Forma exterior del ojo */

.jocarsa-componentes .icono-ojo{

  position:absolute;

  width:18px;
  height:11px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border:2px solid #555;

  border-radius:
    70% 30%
    70% 30%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

}


/* Pupila */

.jocarsa-componentes
.icono-ojo::after{

  content:"";

  position:absolute;

  width:4px;
  height:4px;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#555;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.ojo-password:hover{

  background:#eee;

}


/* ============================================================
   CHECKBOX -> SWITCH
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes .switch{

  position:relative;

  width:48px;
  height:26px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  border-radius:20px;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  background:white;

  transition:
    background 0.25s,
    box-shadow 0.1s,
    transform 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch span{

  position:absolute;

  width:20px;
  height:20px;

  left:2px;
  top:2px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:grey;

  transition:
    left 0.25s,
    background 0.25s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo{

  background:#ddd;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.switch.activo span{

  left:24px;

  background:#222;

}


/* ============================================================
   RADIO
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa{

  position:relative;

  width:26px;
  height:26px;

  border:2px solid grey;

  border-radius:50%;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  cursor:pointer;

  background:white;

  transition:
    box-shadow 0.1s,
    transform 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa span{

  position:absolute;

  width:0;
  height:0;

  left:50%;
  top:50%;

  transform:
    translate(-50%,-50%);

  border-radius:50%;

  background:#333;

  transition:
    width 0.2s,
    height 0.2s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.radio-jocarsa.activo span{

  width:14px;
  height:14px;

}


/* ============================================================
   TEXTAREA
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.campo-textarea{

  min-height:120px;

  white-space:pre-wrap;

  overflow:auto;

}


/* ============================================================
   BOTONES
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa{

  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  padding:10px 20px;

  border:1px solid grey;

  background:white;

  cursor:pointer;

  user-select:none;

  box-sizing:border-box;

  transition:
    background 0.15s,
    transform 0.1s,
    box-shadow 0.1s;

}


.jocarsa-componentes
.boton-jocarsa:hover{

  background:#eee;

}


/*
  Al hacer click el elemento
  se hunde ligeramente.
*/

.jocarsa-componentes
.clickable:active{

  transform:
    translate(2px,2px);

  box-shadow:
    2px 2px 0px
    rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

}


/* ============================================================
   FOCUS
   ============================================================ */

.jocarsa-componentes
.clickable:focus{

  outline:1px solid #555;

  outline-offset:3px;

}
/* ============================================================
   SELECT / COMBOBOX BUSCABLE
   ============================================================ */
.jocarsa-componentes .control-select{position:relative;overflow:visible}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-jocarsa{display:flex;flex:1;position:relative;min-width:0}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-campo{flex:1;padding-right:38px}
.jocarsa-componentes .combo-flecha{width:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid grey;border-left:0;background:#eee;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;z-index:1000;max-height:240px;overflow:auto;background:white;border:1px solid grey;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-lista.abierta{display:block}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;background:white;cursor:pointer}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion:hover,.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada{background:#eee}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.seleccionada::before{content:"✓ ";font-weight:bold}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-opcion.disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:none}
.jocarsa-componentes .select-grupo{padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;background:#ddd;text-transform:uppercase;position:sticky;top:0}
.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa{flex:1;position:relative;border:1px solid grey;background:white;min-height:40px}

.jocarsa-componentes .multiselect-jocarsa .select-lista{position:relative;top:auto;left:auto;right:auto;border:0;box-shadow:none;max-height:180px}

/* OUTPUT / PROGRESS / METER */
.jocarsa-componentes .salida-jocarsa{background:#eee}
.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:40px;border:1px solid grey;background:white;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box}

.jocarsa-componentes .barra-jocarsa span{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;font-size:12px}

/* Paleta común de la interfaz */
:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--color:var(--azul);--color2:var(--naranja);--color3:var(--blanco)}
```
