**andrei-componentes-ampliado.js**
```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){

  // ============================================================
  // CONFIGURACIÓN / UTILIDADES
  // ============================================================

  const TIPOS = {
    text: "T",
    number: "1",
    password: "*",
    email: "@",
    tel: "TEL",
    url: "URL",
    search: "?",
    date: "D",
    time: "H",
    "datetime-local": "DT",
    month: "M",
    week: "W",
    color: "RGB",
    range: "-",
    file: "F"
  }


  function crearContenedor(elemento){

    let contenedor = document.createElement("div")

    contenedor.classList.add(
      "jocarsa-componentes"
    )

    /*
      Guardamos información del control original
    */

    contenedor.dataset.name =
      elemento.name || ""

    contenedor.dataset.id =
      elemento.id || ""

    contenedor.dataset.required =
      elemento.required ? "true" : "false"


    /*
      Insertamos el nuevo componente justo
      después del elemento original.
    */

    elemento.after(contenedor)


    /*
      Si justo antes había un LABEL,
      lo movemos dentro del componente.
    */

    let anterior =
      elemento.previousElementSibling

    if(
      anterior &&
      anterior.tagName === "LABEL"
    ){

      contenedor.appendChild(
        anterior
      )

    }


    return contenedor
  }


  function crearControl(){

    let control =
      document.createElement("div")

    control.classList.add(
      "control"
    )

    return control
  }


  function crearCampo(valor = ""){

    let campo =
      document.createElement("div")

    campo.classList.add(
      "campo",
      "focusable"
    )

    campo.setAttribute(
      "contenteditable",
      "true"
    )

    campo.setAttribute(
      "tabindex",
      "0"
    )

    campo.textContent =
      valor

    return campo
  }


  function crearTipo(texto){

    let tipo =
      document.createElement("span")

    tipo.classList.add(
      "tipo-input"
    )

    tipo.textContent =
      texto

    return tipo
  }


  function estadoNeutro(campo){

    campo.classList.remove(
      "valido",
      "invalido"
    )
  }


  function estadoValido(campo){

    campo.classList.add(
      "valido"
    )

    campo.classList.remove(
      "invalido"
    )
  }


  function estadoInvalido(campo){

    campo.classList.add(
      "invalido"
    )

    campo.classList.remove(
      "valido"
    )
  }


  // ============================================================
  // VALIDADORES
  // ============================================================

  function validarEmail(valor){

    let expresion =
      /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

    return expresion.test(valor)
  }


  function validarURL(valor){

    try{

      let url =
        new URL(valor)

      return (
        url.protocol === "http:" ||
        url.protocol === "https:"
      )

    }catch(error){

      return false
    }
  }


  function validarNumero(valor){

    if(valor.trim() === ""){
      return false
    }

    return (
      !isNaN(valor) &&
      isFinite(valor)
    )
  }


  // ============================================================
  // VALIDAR FORMULARIO JOCARSA
  // ============================================================

  function validarFormulario(formulario){

    let correcto = true

    let componentes =
      formulario.querySelectorAll(
        ".jocarsa-componentes[data-name]"
      )


    componentes.forEach(
      function(componente){

        let requerido =
          componente.dataset.required === "true"

        let tipo =
          componente.dataset.tipo

        let valor =
          componente.dataset.valor || ""


        // REQUIRED

        if(requerido){

          if(
            tipo === "checkbox" ||
            tipo === "radio"
          ){

            if(
              componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
            ){

              correcto = false

            }

          }else{

            if(valor.trim() === ""){

              correcto = false

              let campo =
                componente.querySelector(
                  ".campo"
                )

              if(campo){

                estadoInvalido(
                  campo
                )

              }

            }

          }

        }


        // EMAIL

        if(
          tipo === "email" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarEmail(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }


        // URL

        if(
          tipo === "url" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarURL(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }


        // NUMBER

        if(
          tipo === "number" &&
          valor !== "" &&
          !validarNumero(valor)
        ){

          correcto = false

        }

      }
    )


    return correcto
  }


  // ============================================================
  // ENVÍO POST
  // ============================================================

  function enviarFormularioJocarsa(
    formulario,
    botonSubmit = null
  ){

    if(
      !validarFormulario(
        formulario
      )
    ){

      console.warn(
        "Formulario no válido"
      )

      let primero =
        formulario.querySelector(
          ".campo.invalido"
        )

      if(primero){
        primero.focus()
      }

      return
    }


    /*
      Creamos un formulario temporal.
    */

    let formularioPost =
      document.createElement("form")


    formularioPost.method =
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaMethod ||
      "POST"


    formularioPost.action =
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaAction ||
      window.location.href


    /*
      Si había target, lo conservamos.
    */

    if(
      formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget
    ){

      formularioPost.target =
        formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget

    }


    /*
      Recorremos nuestros componentes.
    */

    let componentes =
      formulario.querySelectorAll(
        ".jocarsa-componentes[data-name]"
      )


    componentes.forEach(
      function(componente){

        let nombre =
          componente.dataset.name

        let tipo =
          componente.dataset.tipo

        let valor =
          componente.dataset.valor || ""


        /*
          Sin NAME no se envía.
        */

        if(!nombre){
          return
        }


        /*
          Checkbox desactivado:
          HTML normal tampoco lo envía.
        */

        if(
          tipo === "checkbox" &&
          componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
        ){
          return
        }


        /*
          Radio no seleccionado:
          tampoco se envía.
        */

        if(
          tipo === "radio" &&
          componente.dataset.checked !== "true"
        ){
          return
        }


        /*
          Creamos un input hidden temporal.
        */

        let hidden =
          document.createElement("input")

        hidden.type =
          "hidden"

        hidden.name =
          nombre

        hidden.value =
          valor


        formularioPost.appendChild(
          hidden
        )

      }
    )


    /*
      Si el submit tenía NAME/VALUE,
      también lo enviamos.
    */

    if(
      botonSubmit &&
      botonSubmit.dataset.name
    ){

      let hidden =
        document.createElement("input")

      hidden.type =
        "hidden"

      hidden.name =
        botonSubmit.dataset.name

      hidden.value =
        botonSubmit.dataset.valor || ""


      formularioPost.appendChild(
        hidden
      )

    }


    /*
      Añadimos temporalmente al DOM.
    */

    document.body.appendChild(
      formularioPost
    )


    /*
      POST real tradicional.
    */

    formularioPost.submit()

  }


  // ============================================================
  // PREPARAMOS LOS FORMULARIOS
  // ============================================================

  let formularios =
    document.querySelectorAll("form")


  formularios.forEach(
    function(formulario){

      /*
        Guardamos configuración original.
      */

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaAction =
        formulario.getAttribute("action") ||
        window.location.href

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaMethod =
        (
          formulario.getAttribute("method") ||
          "POST"
        ).toUpperCase()

      formulario.dataset.jocarsaTarget =
        formulario.getAttribute("target") ||
        ""

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // INPUTS
  // ============================================================

  let entradas =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "input"
      )
    )


  entradas.forEach(
    function(entrada){

      let tipoOriginal =
        entrada.type.toLowerCase()

      let valorOriginal =
        entrada.value

      let formulario =
        entrada.closest("form")


      // ========================================================
      // HIDDEN
      // ========================================================

      /*
        Aunque visualmente no existe,
        debemos conservar su valor para POST.
      */

      if(tipoOriginal === "hidden"){

        if(formulario){

          let almacen =
            document.createElement("div")

          almacen.classList.add(
            "jocarsa-componentes",
            "jocarsa-hidden"
          )

          almacen.dataset.tipo =
            "hidden"

          almacen.dataset.name =
            entrada.name || ""

          almacen.dataset.valor =
            entrada.value || ""

          almacen.style.display =
            "none"


          entrada.after(
            almacen
          )

        }

        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // SUBMIT
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "submit"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "submit"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.value || "Enviar"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Enviar"


        function enviar(){

          if(formulario){

            enviarFormularioJocarsa(
              formulario,
              contenedor
            )

          }

        }


        boton.addEventListener(
          "click",
          enviar
        )


        boton.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === "Enter" ||
              event.key === " "
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              enviar()

            }

          }
        )


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // RESET
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "reset"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "reset"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Restablecer"


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // BUTTON
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "button"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "button"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let boton =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        boton.classList.add(
          "boton-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        boton.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        boton.textContent =
          entrada.value ||
          "Botón"


        control.appendChild(
          boton
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // CHECKBOX
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "checkbox"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "checkbox"

        contenedor.dataset.checkboxValue =
          entrada.value || "on"

        contenedor.dataset.checked =
          entrada.checked
            ? "true"
            : "false"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.checked
            ? (
                entrada.value ||
                "on"
              )
            : ""


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let switchControl =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        switchControl.classList.add(
          "switch",
          "clickable"
        )

        switchControl.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        switchControl.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "checkbox"
        )


        let circulo =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        switchControl.appendChild(
          circulo
        )


        function actualizar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked ===
            "true"


          switchControl.classList.toggle(
            "activo",
            activo
          )

          switchControl.setAttribute(
            "aria-checked",
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"
          )


          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            activo
              ? contenedor.dataset.checkboxValue
              : ""

        }


        function cambiar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked !==
            "true"

          contenedor.dataset.checked =
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"

          actualizar()

        }


        switchControl.addEventListener(
          "click",
          cambiar
        )


        switchControl.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              cambiar()

            }

          }
        )


        actualizar()


        control.appendChild(
          switchControl
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // RADIO
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "radio"){

        let contenedor =
          crearContenedor(
            entrada
          )

        contenedor.dataset.tipo =
          "radio"

        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          entrada.value || "on"

        contenedor.dataset.checked =
          entrada.checked
            ? "true"
            : "false"


        let control =
          crearControl()


        let radio =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        radio.classList.add(
          "radio-jocarsa",
          "clickable"
        )

        radio.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )

        radio.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "radio"
        )


        let interior =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        radio.appendChild(
          interior
        )


        function actualizar(){

          let activo =
            contenedor.dataset.checked ===
            "true"


          radio.classList.toggle(
            "activo",
            activo
          )

          radio.setAttribute(
            "aria-checked",
            activo
              ? "true"
              : "false"
          )

        }


        function activar(){

          /*
            Desactivamos solamente radios
            con el MISMO NAME.
          */

          if(formulario){

            let radios =
              formulario.querySelectorAll(
                '.jocarsa-componentes[data-tipo="radio"]'
              )


            radios.forEach(
              function(otro){

                if(
                  otro.dataset.name ===
                  contenedor.dataset.name
                ){

                  otro.dataset.checked =
                    "false"

                  let visual =
                    otro.querySelector(
                      ".radio-jocarsa"
                    )

                  if(visual){

                    visual.classList.remove(
                      "activo"
                    )

                    visual.setAttribute(
                      "aria-checked",
                      "false"
                    )

                  }

                }

              }
            )

          }


          contenedor.dataset.checked =
            "true"

          actualizar()

        }


        radio.addEventListener(
          "click",
          activar
        )


        radio.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              activar()

            }

          }
        )


        actualizar()


        control.appendChild(
          radio
        )

        contenedor.appendChild(
          control
        )


        entrada.remove()

        return
      }


      // ========================================================
      // INPUT NORMAL
      // ========================================================

      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          entrada
        )

      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        tipoOriginal

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        valorOriginal


      /*
        Conservamos restricciones interesantes.
      */

      if(entrada.min !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.min =
          entrada.min
      }

      if(entrada.max !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.max =
          entrada.max
      }

      if(entrada.step !== ""){
        contenedor.dataset.step =
          entrada.step
      }

      if(entrada.placeholder){

        contenedor.dataset.placeholder =
          entrada.placeholder

      }


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let campo =
        crearCampo(
          valorOriginal
        )


      let tipo =
        crearTipo(
          TIPOS[tipoOriginal] ||
          "?"
        )


      // ========================================================
      // SINCRONIZACIÓN
      // ========================================================

      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          if(
            tipoOriginal !==
            "password"
          ){

            contenedor.dataset.valor =
              campo.textContent

          }

        }
      )


      // ========================================================
      // EMAIL
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "email"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

          }else if(
            validarEmail(valor)
          ){

            estadoValido(
              campo
            )

          }else{

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

          }

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // URL
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "url"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

          }else if(
            validarURL(valor)
          ){

            estadoValido(
              campo
            )

          }else{

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

          }

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // NUMBER
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "number"){

        function comprobar(){

          let valor =
            campo.textContent.trim()

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            valor


          if(valor === ""){

            estadoNeutro(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          if(
            !validarNumero(valor)
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          let numero =
            Number(valor)


          if(
            contenedor.dataset.min !== undefined &&
            contenedor.dataset.min !== "" &&
            numero <
            Number(
              contenedor.dataset.min
            )
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          if(
            contenedor.dataset.max !== undefined &&
            contenedor.dataset.max !== "" &&
            numero >
            Number(
              contenedor.dataset.max
            )
          ){

            estadoInvalido(
              campo
            )

            return
          }


          estadoValido(
            campo
          )

        }


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          comprobar
        )

        comprobar()
      }


      // ========================================================
      // PASSWORD
      // ========================================================

      if(tipoOriginal === "password"){

        let valorReal =
          valorOriginal

        let visible =
          false


        contenedor.dataset.valor =
          valorReal


        campo.textContent =
          "*".repeat(
            valorReal.length
          )


        let ojo =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          )

        ojo.classList.add(
          "ojo-password",
          "clickable"
        )

        ojo.setAttribute(
          "role",
          "button"
        )

        ojo.setAttribute(
          "tabindex",
          "0"
        )


        let icono =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          )

        icono.classList.add(
          "icono-ojo"
        )

        ojo.appendChild(
          icono
        )


        function mostrarOcultar(){

          visible =
            !visible


          if(visible){

            campo.textContent =
              valorReal

            ojo.classList.add(
              "activo"
            )

          }else{

            /*
              Si estaba visible,
              recogemos el valor editado.
            */

            valorReal =
              campo.textContent

            contenedor.dataset.valor =
              valorReal

            campo.textContent =
              "*".repeat(
                valorReal.length
              )

            ojo.classList.remove(
              "activo"
            )

          }

        }


        ojo.addEventListener(
          "click",
          mostrarOcultar
        )


        ojo.addEventListener(
          "keydown",
          function(event){

            if(
              event.key === " " ||
              event.key === "Enter"
            ){

              event.preventDefault()

              mostrarOcultar()

            }

          }
        )


        campo.addEventListener(
          "input",
          function(){

            if(visible){

              valorReal =
                campo.textContent

              contenedor.dataset.valor =
                valorReal

            }

          }
        )


        control.appendChild(
          campo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          ojo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          tipo
        )

      }else{

        control.appendChild(
          campo
        )

        control.appendChild(
          tipo
        )

      }


      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      /*
        AHORA SÍ:
        destruimos completamente
        el input original.
      */

      entrada.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // TEXTAREA
  // ============================================================

  let textareas =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "textarea"
      )
    )


  textareas.forEach(
    function(textarea){

      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          textarea
        )


      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        "textarea"

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        textarea.value


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let campo =
        crearCampo(
          textarea.value
        )


      campo.classList.add(
        "campo-textarea"
      )


      let tipo =
        crearTipo("TXT")


      campo.addEventListener(
        "input",
        function(){

          contenedor.dataset.valor =
            campo.textContent

        }
      )


      control.appendChild(
        campo
      )

      control.appendChild(
        tipo
      )


      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      textarea.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // BUTTON NATIVO
  // ============================================================

  let botones =
    Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "button"
      )
    )


  botones.forEach(
    function(botonOriginal){

      /*
        Ignoramos cualquier botón que ya
        pertenezca a nuestros componentes.
      */

      if(
        botonOriginal.closest(
          ".jocarsa-componentes"
        )
      ){
        return
      }


      let formulario =
        botonOriginal.closest(
          "form"
        )


      let tipoOriginal =
        (
          botonOriginal.type ||
          "submit"
        ).toLowerCase()


      let contenedor =
        crearContenedor(
          botonOriginal
        )


      contenedor.dataset.tipo =
        tipoOriginal

      contenedor.dataset.name =
        botonOriginal.name || ""

      contenedor.dataset.valor =
        botonOriginal.value || ""


      let control =
        crearControl()


      let boton =
        document.createElement(
          "div"
        )


      boton.classList.add(
        "boton-jocarsa",
        "clickable"
      )


      boton.setAttribute(
        "role",
        "button"
      )

      boton.setAttribute(
        "tabindex",
        "0"
      )


      boton.innerHTML =
        botonOriginal.innerHTML


      function ejecutar(){

        if(
          tipoOriginal === "submit"
        ){

          if(formulario){

            enviarFormularioJocarsa(
              formulario,
              contenedor
            )

          }

        }else if(
          tipoOriginal === "reset"
        ){

          /*
            Podemos implementar después
            restauración completa de estados.
          */

          console.log(
            "Reset JOCARSA"
          )

        }

      }


      boton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        ejecutar
      )


      boton.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        function(event){

          if(
            event.key === " " ||
            event.key === "Enter"
          ){

            event.preventDefault()

            ejecutar()

          }

        }
      )


      control.appendChild(
        boton
      )

      contenedor.appendChild(
        control
      )


      botonOriginal.remove()

    }
  )


  // ============================================================
  // SELECT -> COMBOBOX BUSCABLE / MULTISELECT
  // ============================================================
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("select")).forEach(function(selectOriginal){
    if(selectOriginal.closest(".jocarsa-componentes")) return

    const contenedor = crearContenedor(selectOriginal)
    contenedor.dataset.tipo = selectOriginal.multiple ? "select-multiple" : "select"
    contenedor.dataset.disabled = selectOriginal.disabled ? "true" : "false"

    const opciones = Array.from(selectOriginal.options).map(function(op){
      return {
        value: op.value,
        text: op.textContent,
        disabled: op.disabled,
        selected: op.selected,
        group: op.parentElement && op.parentElement.tagName === "OPTGROUP" ? op.parentElement.label : ""
      }
    })

    const control = crearControl()
    control.classList.add("control-select")

    if(selectOriginal.multiple){
      const caja = document.createElement("div")
      caja.className = "multiselect-jocarsa focusable"
      caja.tabIndex = selectOriginal.disabled ? -1 : 0
      const buscador = document.createElement("div")
      buscador.className = "select-buscador"
      buscador.contentEditable = selectOriginal.disabled ? "false" : "true"
      buscador.dataset.placeholder = "Buscar..."
      const lista = document.createElement("div")
      lista.className = "select-lista abierta"
      caja.append(buscador, lista)

      let seleccionados = opciones.filter(o=>o.selected && !o.disabled).map(o=>o.value)
      function pintar(filtro=""){
        lista.innerHTML=""
        opciones.filter(o=>o.text.toLowerCase().includes(filtro.toLowerCase())).forEach(function(o){
          const item=document.createElement("div")
          item.className="select-opcion clickable"+(seleccionados.includes(o.value)?" seleccionada":"")+(o.disabled?" disabled":"")
          item.textContent=(o.group ? o.group+" · " : "")+o.text
          if(!o.disabled && !selectOriginal.disabled) item.onclick=function(){
            seleccionados.includes(o.value) ? seleccionados=seleccionados.filter(v=>v!==o.value) : seleccionados.push(o.value)
            contenedor.dataset.valor=JSON.stringify(seleccionados)
            pintar(buscador.textContent.trim())
          }
          lista.appendChild(item)
        })
      }
      buscador.addEventListener("input",()=>pintar(buscador.textContent.trim()))
      contenedor.dataset.valor=JSON.stringify(seleccionados)
      contenedor.dataset.multiple="true"
      pintar()
      control.append(caja, crearTipo("SEL"))
    }else{
      const combo=document.createElement("div")
      combo.className="combo-jocarsa"
      const campo=crearCampo("")
      campo.classList.add("combo-campo")
      campo.contentEditable=selectOriginal.disabled ? "false" : "true"
      campo.tabIndex=selectOriginal.disabled ? -1 : 0
      const flecha=document.createElement("div")
      flecha.className="combo-flecha clickable"
      flecha.textContent="▾"
      const lista=document.createElement("div")
      lista.className="select-lista"
      combo.append(campo,flecha,lista)

      let elegida=opciones.find(o=>o.selected) || opciones[0] || null
      function elegir(o){
        elegida=o
        campo.textContent=o ? o.text : ""
        contenedor.dataset.valor=o ? o.value : ""
        lista.classList.remove("abierta")
      }
      function pintar(filtro=""){
        lista.innerHTML=""
        let grupoAnterior=null
        opciones.filter(o=>o.text.toLowerCase().includes(filtro.toLowerCase())).forEach(function(o){
          if(o.group && o.group!==grupoAnterior){
            const g=document.createElement("div"); g.className="select-grupo"; g.textContent=o.group; lista.appendChild(g); grupoAnterior=o.group
          }
          const item=document.createElement("div")
          item.className="select-opcion clickable"+(o.disabled?" disabled":"")
          item.textContent=o.text
          if(!o.disabled && !selectOriginal.disabled) item.addEventListener("mousedown",function(e){e.preventDefault(); elegir(o)})
          lista.appendChild(item)
        })
      }
      campo.addEventListener("focus",function(){ pintar(campo.textContent.trim()); lista.classList.add("abierta") })
      campo.addEventListener("input",function(){ contenedor.dataset.valor=""; pintar(campo.textContent.trim()); lista.classList.add("abierta") })
      campo.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){ if(e.key==="Escape") lista.classList.remove("abierta") })
      flecha.addEventListener("click",function(){ if(selectOriginal.disabled)return; pintar(""); lista.classList.toggle("abierta"); campo.focus() })
      document.addEventListener("mousedown",function(e){ if(!combo.contains(e.target)) lista.classList.remove("abierta") })
      elegir(elegida)
      control.append(combo,crearTipo("SEL"))
    }
    contenedor.appendChild(control)
    selectOriginal.remove()
  })

  // ============================================================
  // OUTPUT / PROGRESS / METER -> REPRESENTACIÓN JOCARSA
  // ============================================================
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("output, progress, meter")).forEach(function(original){
    if(original.closest(".jocarsa-componentes")) return
    const tag=original.tagName.toLowerCase()
    const contenedor=crearContenedor(original)
    contenedor.dataset.tipo=tag
    contenedor.dataset.name=original.getAttribute("name") || ""
    const control=crearControl()

    if(tag==="output"){
      const campo=document.createElement("div")
      campo.className="campo salida-jocarsa"
      campo.textContent=original.value || original.textContent
      contenedor.dataset.valor=campo.textContent
      control.append(campo,crearTipo("OUT"))
    }else{
      const min=tag==="meter" ? Number(original.min||0) : 0
      const max=Number(original.max||1)
      const value=Number(original.value||0)
      const pct=max>min ? Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(value-min)/(max-min)*100)) : 0
      const barra=document.createElement("div")
      barra.className="barra-jocarsa"
      const relleno=document.createElement("div")
      relleno.className="barra-jocarsa-relleno"
      relleno.style.width=pct+"%"
      const texto=document.createElement("span")
      texto.textContent=tag==="progress" && !original.hasAttribute("value") ? "…" : value+" / "+max
      barra.append(relleno,texto)
      control.append(barra,crearTipo(tag==="meter"?"MTR":"PRG"))
    }
    contenedor.appendChild(control)
    original.remove()
  })

})

#### 010-andrei-componentes
**README.md**
```markdown
# jocarsa | componentes

Librería CSS/JS sin dependencias, inspirada en el patrón jocarsa-iu de Habla.

## Uso

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="jocarsa-componentes-ampliado.css">
<script src="jocarsa-componentes-ampliado.js" defer></script>
```

Los controles HTML originales se conservan en el DOM: mantienen sus `name`, `id`, `value`, validaciones, envío `FormData` y eventos. Se mejoran visualmente los tipos de texto, fecha, hora, mes, semana, número, rango, color, archivo, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, botones, output, meter y progress.

### Multiselector

```html
<select name="lenguajes[]" multiple data-placeholder="Buscar lenguaje">
  <optgroup label="Backend"><option>Python</option><option>PHP</option></optgroup>
  <option>JavaScript</option>
</select>
```

Se envía cada opción seleccionada como valor del select nativo. El filtro busca en el texto de las opciones.

### Botonera deslizante

```html
<div data-jc-segmented data-name="periodo" data-value="mes" data-storage-key="periodo-demo">
  <button data-valor="año">Año</button>
  <button data-valor="mes">Mes</button>
  <button data-valor="semana">Semana</button>
</div>
```

`data-storage-key` es opcional. Se emite `jc:change` con `event.detail.value`. `data-name` genera un campo hidden para el formulario.

### Inicialización de contenido dinámico

```js
JocarsaComponentes.init(document.querySelector('#contenedor'));
```

La inicialización es idempotente. Variables CSS `--tono`, `--saturacion`, `--brillo`, `--escalon`, `--chaflan` y `--relleno` compatibles con jocarsa-iu.

## Nota

Los selectores de fecha y hora emplean el control nativo del navegador para mantener accesibilidad, teclado, idioma y validación. El aspecto del calendario desplegable depende del navegador/sistema operativo. Los `select[multiple]` tienen representación personalizada, pero el elemento select original permanece como fuente de verdad.

```

```css
/* jocarsa | componentes · variables heredadas de jocarsa-iu */
:root{--tono:200;--saturacion:50%;--brillo:30%;--escalon:20%;--relleno:12px;--texto:13px;--chaflan:10px;--color0:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) - var(--escalon)));--color:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),var(--brillo));--color2:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)));--color3:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)*2));--color4:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)*3))}
.jocarsa-componentes,.jc-demo{font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:var(--texto);color:#172033}
.jc-control{display:inline-flex;align-items:stretch;position:relative;vertical-align:middle;min-width:180px;max-width:100%;min-height:40px;border:1px solid #b9c6d3;background:#f8fafc;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - var(--chaflan)) 0,100% var(--chaflan),100% 100%,0 100%);transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
.jc-control:focus-within{border-color:var(--color);background:white;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color)}
.jc-control:has(:disabled){opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
.jc-control>input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=hidden]),.jc-control>textarea,.jc-control>select{flex:1;min-width:0;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:10px 12px;outline:0;color:#172033;font:inherit}
.jc-control>textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.jc-control>input[type=color]{min-width:90px;height:40px;padding:5px;cursor:pointer}
.jc-control>input[type=range]{min-width:150px;accent-color:var(--color)}
.jc-control>input[type=file]{max-width:270px;font-size:11px}
.jc-control>input[type=file]::file-selector-button{background:var(--color);color:white;border:0;padding:7px;cursor:pointer}
.jc-addon,.jc-type,.jc-range-value,.jc-color-value,.jc-file-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-left:1px solid #cdd5df;background:#e9eff4;color:#405568;font:inherit}
.jc-addon{cursor:pointer}.jc-addon:hover{background:var(--color2);color:#111}.jc-type{font:700 10px Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif}
.jc-file-label{max-width:180px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.jc-choice{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;vertical-align:middle;margin:4px}.jc-choice input{accent-color:var(--color);width:18px;height:18px;cursor:pointer}
.jc-button{border:0;background:var(--color);color:white;padding:10px 17px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - var(--chaflan)) 0,100% var(--chaflan),100% 100%,0 100%)}.jc-button:hover{background:var(--color0)}.jc-button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.jc-indicator{accent-color:var(--color);max-width:100%}
.jc-original-select{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;overflow:hidden!important;padding:0!important}
.jc-control:has(.jc-multi){display:inline-flex;min-width:min(360px,100%);overflow:visible;clip-path:none}
.jc-multi{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:6px;gap:6px}.jc-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.jc-chip{border:0;background:var(--color);color:white;padding:5px 9px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 7px) 0,100% 7px,100% 100%,0 100%)}.jc-chip:hover{background:var(--color0)}
.jc-multi-search{border:1px solid #d4dde5;background:white;padding:9px;outline:none;width:100%;font:inherit}.jc-multi-search:focus{border-color:var(--color)}
.jc-multi-menu{max-height:170px;overflow:auto;border-top:1px solid #d4dde5}.jc-multi-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px;cursor:pointer}.jc-multi-option:hover{background:var(--color3)}.jc-multi-option input{accent-color:var(--color)}.jc-empty{padding:10px;color:#64748b}.jc-disabled{opacity:.55}
.jc-segmented{display:inline-flex;position:relative;isolation:isolate;background:#e8edf2;padding:5px;max-width:100%;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow:auto;gap:0}.jc-segmented button{position:relative;z-index:1;border:0;background:transparent;padding:12px 18px;min-width:70px;color:#536477;cursor:pointer;font:600 13px Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .25s}.jc-segmented button.activo{color:white}.jc-segment-indicator{position:absolute;z-index:0;left:0;top:5px;height:calc(100% - 10px);background:var(--color);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),width .35s ease;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 9px) 0,100% 9px,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.jc-control :invalid:not(:placeholder-shown){outline-offset:-2px}.jc-demo label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font-weight:600}.jc-demo label:has(.jc-choice){flex-direction:row;align-items:center}.jc-demo .jc-control{width:100%}
@media(max-width:600px){.jc-control{min-width:0;width:100%}.jc-file-label{display:none}.jc-segmented button{min-width:55px;padding:10px}}

/* Paleta común de la interfaz */
:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--color0:var(--negro);--color:var(--azul);--color2:var(--naranja);--color3:var(--blanco)}
.jocarsa-componentes,.jc-demo{color:var(--negro)}
.jc-control{border-color:var(--azul);background:var(--blanco)}
.jc-control:focus-within{border-color:var(--naranja);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--naranja)}
.jc-button,.jc-chip,.jc-segment-indicator{background:var(--azul)}
.jc-button:hover,.jc-chip:hover{background:var(--naranja)}

**jocarsa-componentes-ampliado.js**
```js
/* jocarsa | componentes · mejora progresiva sin sustituir controles nativos */
(function(){'use strict';
const types={text:'TXT',email:'@',password:'***',search:'⌕',tel:'TEL',url:'URL',number:'123',date:'FECHA',time:'HORA','datetime-local':'FECHA/H',month:'MES',week:'SEM',color:'COLOR',file:'ARCH',range:'RANGO'};
function emit(el){el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}
function enhance(root=document){
 root.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select,button,output,progress,meter').forEach(el=>{
  if(el.dataset.jcReady||el.closest('.jc-control')||el.closest('.jc-segmented')||el.type==='hidden')return;
  el.dataset.jcReady='1';
  if(el.matches('input[type=radio],input[type=checkbox]')){const wrap=document.createElement('span');wrap.className='jc-choice';el.before(wrap);wrap.append(el);return;}
  if(el.matches('button,input[type=button],input[type=submit],input[type=reset],input[type=image]')){el.classList.add('jc-button');return;}
  if(el.matches('progress,meter,output')){el.classList.add('jc-indicator');return;}
  const wrap=document.createElement('span');wrap.className='jc-control';el.before(wrap);wrap.append(el);
  if(el.matches('select[multiple]')){makeMulti(el,wrap);return;}
  if(el.matches('select')){el.classList.add('jc-native-select');return;}
  if(el.matches('textarea'))return;
  if(el.type==='range'){const out=document.createElement('output');out.className='jc-range-value';out.textContent=el.value;wrap.append(out);el.addEventListener('input',()=>out.textContent=el.value);return;}
  if(el.type==='file'){const out=document.createElement('span');out.className='jc-file-label';out.textContent='Ningún archivo';wrap.append(out);el.addEventListener('change',()=>out.textContent=Array.from(el.files).map(f=>f.name).join(', ')||'Ningún archivo');return;}
  if(el.type==='password'){const eye=document.createElement('button');eye.type='button';eye.className='jc-addon jc-eye';eye.textContent='Mostrar';eye.setAttribute('aria-label','Mostrar contraseña');eye.onclick=()=>{const visible=el.type==='password';el.type=visible?'text':'password';eye.textContent=visible?'Ocultar':'Mostrar';eye.setAttribute('aria-label',eye.textContent+' contraseña');};wrap.append(eye);}
  if(['date','time','datetime-local','month','week'].includes(el.type)){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='jc-addon';b.textContent='▦';b.title='Abrir selector';b.disabled=el.disabled||el.readOnly;b.onclick=()=>{try{el.showPicker()}catch(e){el.focus()}};wrap.append(b);}
  if(el.type==='color'){const out=document.createElement('span');out.className='jc-color-value';out.textContent=el.value;wrap.append(out);el.addEventListener('input',()=>out.textContent=el.value);}
  if(types[el.type]&&!['password','date','time','datetime-local','month','week','color'].includes(el.type)){const tag=document.createElement('span');tag.className='jc-type';tag.textContent=types[el.type];wrap.append(tag);}
 });
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-jc-segmented]').forEach(makeSegmented);
}
function makeMulti(el,wrap){
 const panel=document.createElement('div');panel.className='jc-multi';panel.tabIndex=-1;
 const tags=document.createElement('div');tags.className='jc-tags';const search=document.createElement('input');search.type='search';search.className='jc-multi-search';search.placeholder=el.dataset.placeholder||'Buscar opciones…';search.setAttribute('aria-label','Buscar opciones');const menu=document.createElement('div');menu.className='jc-multi-menu';menu.setAttribute('role','listbox');menu.setAttribute('aria-multiselectable','true');panel.append(tags,search,menu);wrap.append(panel);el.classList.add('jc-original-select');
 function draw(){tags.replaceChildren();for(const opt of el.selectedOptions){const chip=document.createElement('button');chip.type='button';chip.className='jc-chip';chip.textContent=opt.textContent+' ×';chip.disabled=el.disabled;chip.title='Quitar '+opt.textContent;chip.onclick=()=>{opt.selected=false;emit(el);draw();};tags.append(chip)}menu.replaceChildren();let count=0;const term=search.value.toLocaleLowerCase();for(const opt of el.options){if(opt.hidden||!opt.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(term))continue;count++;const row=document.createElement('label');row.className='jc-multi-option';const cb=document.createElement('input');cb.type='checkbox';cb.checked=opt.selected;cb.disabled=el.disabled||opt.disabled;cb.onchange=()=>{opt.selected=cb.checked;emit(el);draw();search.focus()};const text=document.createElement('span');text.textContent=(opt.parentElement.tagName==='OPTGROUP'?opt.parentElement.label+' · ':'')+opt.textContent;row.append(cb,text);menu.append(row)}if(!count){const empty=document.createElement('div');empty.className='jc-empty';empty.textContent='Sin resultados';menu.append(empty)}panel.classList.toggle('jc-disabled',el.disabled);search.disabled=el.disabled;}
 search.addEventListener('input',draw);el.addEventListener('change',draw);el.form?.addEventListener('reset',()=>setTimeout(draw,0));draw();
}
function makeSegmented(host){if(host.dataset.jcSegmentedReady)return;host.dataset.jcSegmentedReady='1';host.classList.add('jc-segmented');const buttons=Array.from(host.querySelectorAll('button'));if(!buttons.length)return;const indicator=document.createElement('span');indicator.className='jc-segment-indicator';indicator.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');host.prepend(indicator);const name=host.dataset.name||'';const hidden=name?document.createElement('input'):null;if(hidden){hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name=name;host.append(hidden)}const key=host.dataset.storageKey;let initial=(key?localStorage.getItem(key):null)||host.dataset.value||buttons.find(b=>b.classList.contains('activo'))?.dataset.valor||buttons[0].dataset.valor;
 function select(btn,notify=true){if(!btn||btn.disabled)return;buttons.forEach(b=>{const active=b===btn;b.classList.toggle('activo',active);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active))});indicator.style.width=btn.offsetWidth+'px';indicator.style.transform='translateX('+btn.offsetLeft+'px)';if(hidden)hidden.value=btn.dataset.valor||btn.textContent.trim();if(key)try{localStorage.setItem(key,hidden?.value||btn.dataset.valor)}catch(e){}if(notify)host.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jc:change',{bubbles:true,detail:{value:hidden?.value||btn.dataset.valor}}));}
 buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{b.type='button';b.onclick=()=>select(b);b.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!['ArrowRight','ArrowLeft','Home','End'].includes(e.key))return;e.preventDefault();let idx=e.key==='Home'?0:e.key==='End'?buttons.length-1:(i+(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1)+buttons.length)%buttons.length;buttons[idx].focus();select(buttons[idx]);});});select(buttons.find(b=>b.dataset.valor===initial)||buttons[0],false);if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined')new ResizeObserver(()=>{const b=buttons.find(b=>b.classList.contains('activo'));if(b){indicator.style.width=b.offsetWidth+'px';indicator.style.transform='translateX('+b.offsetLeft+'px)'}}).observe(host);
}
window.JocarsaComponentes={init:enhance};if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>enhance());else enhance();
})();

```
#### 012-andrei-componentes-v5
**README.md**
```markdown
# jocarsa | componentes v5

Abrir `demo.html`. Integración: cargar `jocarsa-iu.css`, `jocarsa-ui.js` y `jocarsa-extension.js` en ese orden.

- Inputs HTML originales conservados: switches y radios son CSS sobre el input nativo.
- Date/time/datetime-local/month/week: botón adicional abre minimodal propio, manteniendo el input real.
- `jocarsa-texto`, `jocarsa-markdown`, `jocarsa-editor`, `jocarsa-firma`: componentes de formulario del proyecto v4.1.
- `jocarsa-tabla`, `jocarsa-arbol`, `jocarsa-calendario`, `jocarsa-semana`, `jocarsa-hora`: informes y selectores del proyecto v4.1.
- `.jocarsa-segment` convierte una botonera con `data-valor` en selector animado; `name` crea valor de formulario, `data-storage` permite persistencia.

**Limitaciones:** el multiselect del demo es el control nativo; no se ha reconstruido el buscador multiselect de la primera librería. El editor rico heredado utiliza `document.execCommand`, obsoleto. La firma heredada no preserva el trazo al redimensionar. El selector semanal personalizado necesita pruebas de límites de año ISO.

```

**jocarsa-extension.js**
```js
(()=>{'use strict';
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0'),iso=d=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
function notify(el){el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}
function enhanceDate(input){if(input.dataset.jocarsaPicker||input.disabled)return;input.dataset.jocarsaPicker='1';const type=input.type;if(!['date','time','datetime-local','month','week'].includes(type))return;
const wrap=document.createElement('span');wrap.className='jocarsa-date-wrap';input.before(wrap);wrap.append(input);const trigger=document.createElement('button');trigger.type='button';trigger.className='jocarsa-date-trigger';trigger.textContent='▦';trigger.setAttribute('aria-label','Abrir selector de '+type);wrap.append(trigger);
trigger.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.jocarsa-popup').forEach(p=>p.remove());let d=input.value?new Date(input.value.slice(0,10)+'T12:00:00'):new Date();if(isNaN(d))d=new Date();let y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth(),day=d.getDate(),hour=Number((input.value.match(/T?(\d\d):(\d\d)/)||[])[1]||12),minute=Number((input.value.match(/T?(\d\d):(\d\d)/)||[])[2]||0);const pop=document.createElement('div');pop.className='jocarsa-popup';pop.setAttribute('role','dialog');pop.setAttribute('aria-label','Selector de '+type);document.body.append(pop);
const r=trigger.getBoundingClientRect();pop.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(r.left,innerWidth-360))+'px';pop.style.top=Math.max(8,Math.min(r.bottom+5,innerHeight-430))+'px';
function render(){pop.replaceChildren();const head=document.createElement('header');const prev=document.createElement('button'),next=document.createElement('button'),title=document.createElement('strong');prev.textContent='‹';next.textContent='›';title.textContent=new Date(y,m,1).toLocaleDateString('es-ES',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});head.append(prev,title,next);pop.append(head);prev.onclick=()=>{m--;if(m<0){m=11;y--}render()};next.onclick=()=>{m++;if(m>11){m=0;y++}render()};
if(type!=='time'){const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='jcal-grid';['L','M','X','J','V','S','D'].forEach(t=>{const e=document.createElement('b');e.textContent=t;e.style.textAlign='center';grid.append(e)});const offset=(new Date(y,m,1).getDay()+6)%7;for(let i=0;i<42;i++){const date=new Date(y,m,1-offset+i);const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=date.getDate();if(date.getMonth()!==m)b.classList.add('muted');if(iso(date)===`${y}-${pad(m+1)}-${pad(day)}`)b.classList.add('selected');b.onclick=()=>{y=date.getFullYear();m=date.getMonth();day=date.getDate();render()};grid.append(b)}pop.append(grid)}
if(type==='time'||type==='datetime-local'){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='jtime';for(const [value,max,change] of [[hour,23,v=>hour=v],[minute,59,v=>minute=v]]){const sel=document.createElement('select');for(let i=0;i<=max;i++){const o=new Option(pad(i),pad(i),false,i===value);sel.add(o)}sel.onchange=()=>change(+sel.value);row.append(sel)}pop.append(row)}
const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='actions';const cancel=document.createElement('button'),ok=document.createElement('button');cancel.textContent='Cancelar';ok.textContent='Aplicar';cancel.onclick=()=>pop.remove();ok.onclick=()=>{const date=new Date(y,m,day);let v=iso(date);if(type==='month')v=v.slice(0,7);if(type==='time')v=`${pad(hour)}:${pad(minute)}`;if(type==='datetime-local')v+=`T${pad(hour)}:${pad(minute)}`;if(type==='week'){const wd=(date.getDay()+6)%7;date.setDate(date.getDate()-wd+3);const jan4=new Date(date.getFullYear(),0,4);const week=1+Math.round((date-jan4)/604800000);v=`${date.getFullYear()}-W${pad(week)}`;}input.value=v;notify(input);pop.remove()};actions.append(cancel,ok);pop.append(actions)}render();const close=e=>{if(!pop.contains(e.target)&&e.target!==trigger){pop.remove();document.removeEventListener('pointerdown',close)}};setTimeout(()=>document.addEventListener('pointerdown',close),0);pop.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){pop.remove();trigger.focus()}});};}
function enhanceSegment(el){if(el.dataset.ready)return;el.dataset.ready='1';const buttons=[...el.querySelectorAll('button')];if(!buttons.length)return;const indicator=document.createElement('div');indicator.className='indicador';el.prepend(indicator);const hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name=el.getAttribute('name')||'';el.append(hidden);const storage=el.dataset.storage;function select(btn,fire=true){buttons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===btn)));indicator.style.width=btn.offsetWidth+'px';indicator.style.transform=`translateX(${btn.offsetLeft}px)`;hidden.value=btn.dataset.valor||btn.textContent.trim();if(storage)try{localStorage.setItem(storage,hidden.value)}catch{}if(fire)notify(hidden)}buttons.forEach(b=>{b.type='button';b.onclick=()=>select(b)});let value=el.getAttribute('value');if(storage)try{value=localStorage.getItem(storage)||value}catch{};requestAnimationFrame(()=>select(buttons.find(b=>(b.dataset.valor||b.textContent.trim())===value)||buttons[0],false));new ResizeObserver(()=>{const b=buttons.find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true');if(b)select(b,false)}).observe(el)}
function init(root=document){root.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(el=>el.classList.add('jocarsa-switch'));root.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]').forEach(el=>el.classList.add('jocarsa-radio'));root.querySelectorAll('input[type=date],input[type=time],input[type=datetime-local],input[type=month],input[type=week]').forEach(enhanceDate);root.querySelectorAll('.jocarsa-segment').forEach(enhanceSegment);}
window.JocarsaEnhance={init};if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{init();setTimeout(()=>init(),0)});else{init();setTimeout(()=>init(),0)}
})();

**jocarsa-iu.css**
```css

:root{--tono:200;--saturacion:50%;--brillo:30%;--escalon:20%;--color0:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) - var(--escalon)));--color:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),var(--brillo));--color2:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)));--color3:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)*2));--chaflan:10px}
body{font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--color3);color:#172033;margin:0}button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit} .jocarsa-control{font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif!important;border-radius:0!important;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - var(--chaflan)) 0,100% var(--chaflan),100% 100%,0 100%)}.jocarsa-barra{background:var(--color2)!important}.jocarsa-barra button,.jocarsa-cal-cabecera button{border-radius:0!important}.jocarsa-barra button.activo,.jocarsa-cal-dia.seleccionado,.jocarsa-semana-slot.seleccionado{background:var(--color)!important;color:white!important}.jocarsa-input-envoltura{border-radius:0!important}.jocarsa-input-icono{background:var(--color2)!important}
/* Mantener los controles nativos: solo apariencia de checkbox y radio */
.jocarsa-switch{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:48px;height:27px;border:1px solid #667085;border-radius:20px;background:#dbe1e6;position:relative;cursor:pointer;vertical-align:middle;transition:background .25s,box-shadow .2s}
.jocarsa-switch:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:19px;height:19px;left:3px;top:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#64748b;transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.jocarsa-switch:checked{background:var(--color2)}.jocarsa-switch:checked:before{transform:translateX(20px);background:var(--color0)}
.jocarsa-radio{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:26px;height:26px;border:2px solid #64748b;border-radius:50%;background:white;position:relative;vertical-align:middle;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .18s,transform .18s}
.jocarsa-radio:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:50%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--color);transition:inset .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.jocarsa-radio:checked:before{inset:4px}.jocarsa-radio:active{transform:scale(.9)}

.jocarsa-popup{position:fixed;z-index:99999;width:min(350px,calc(100vw - 24px));padding:12px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--color2);box-shadow:0 14px 36px #0003;font:14px Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif}.jocarsa-popup header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--color);color:white;padding:8px}.jocarsa-popup button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #ccd3db;background:white;padding:7px}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;margin-top:8px}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid button{padding:7px 0}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid .selected{background:var(--color);color:white}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid .muted{opacity:.4}.jocarsa-popup .jtime{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0}.jocarsa-popup select{padding:8px;min-width:65px}.jocarsa-popup .actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}.jocarsa-date-trigger{padding:8px;border:1px solid #bbb;background:var(--color2);cursor:pointer}.jocarsa-date-wrap{display:inline-flex;align-items:stretch;gap:3px;max-width:100%}.jocarsa-date-wrap input{min-width:0}.jocarsa-segment{display:inline-flex;position:relative;padding:5px;background:var(--color3);isolation:isolate;gap:0}.jocarsa-segment button{z-index:1;position:relative;background:transparent;border:0;padding:12px 18px;cursor:pointer;color:#334155}.jocarsa-segment button[aria-pressed=true]{color:white}.jocarsa-segment .indicador{position:absolute;z-index:0;top:5px;left:0;height:calc(100% - 10px);background:var(--color);transition:transform .3s,width .3s;pointer-events:none}
.jocarsa-demo{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:24px}.jocarsa-demo section{background:white;padding:20px;margin:16px 0}.jocarsa-demo h1{color:white}.jocarsa-demo>header{background:var(--color);padding:20px}.jocarsa-demo label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:8px}.jocarsa-demo .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}.jocarsa-demo .grid>div{min-width:0}

/* Paleta común de la interfaz */
:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--color0:var(--negro);--color:var(--azul);--color2:var(--naranja);--color3:var(--blanco)}
body{background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro)}
.jocarsa-demo section{border:1px solid var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-demo>header,.jocarsa-popup header,.jocarsa-segment .indicador{background:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-popup{border-color:var(--naranja)}

(function(){

  class JocarsaControl {
    static estilosInstalados = false;

    constructor(elemento, tipo){

      this.placeholder = elemento.getAttribute("placeholder") || "";

      elemento.after(this.raiz);
      elemento.remove();

        .jocarsa-semana{max-width:1000px}.jocarsa-semana-cabecera{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px;background:#f5f5f5;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}.jocarsa-semana-cabecera strong{text-align:center}.jocarsa-semana-cabecera button{padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}.jocarsa-semana-scroll{overflow:auto;max-height:620px}.jocarsa-semana-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:72px repeat(7,minmax(105px,1fr));min-width:820px}.jocarsa-semana-dia{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:5px;background:#eee;border-right:1px solid #ccc;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;box-sizing:border-box}.jocarsa-semana-esquina{left:0;z-index:4}.jocarsa-semana-hora{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;min-height:34px;padding:6px 4px;background:#f7f7f7;border-right:1px solid #ccc;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5;box-sizing:border-box;font:12px monospace;color:#555}.jocarsa-semana-slot{min-height:34px;border-right:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer}.jocarsa-semana-slot:hover{background:#eee}.jocarsa-semana-slot.seleccionado{background:#333;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #111}.jocarsa-semana-valor{padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid #ddd;font:13px monospace;color:#555}

        .jocarsa-input{max-width:520px;overflow:visible;border:0;background:transparent;margin:8px 0}.jocarsa-input-envoltura{display:flex;align-items:stretch;width:100%;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}.jocarsa-input-envoltura:focus-within{border-color:#333;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}.jocarsa-input-icono{width:46px;flex:0 0 46px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#f2f2f2;border-right:1px solid #ddd;font:700 18px/1 Arial,sans-serif;color:#333;user-select:none;filter:grayscale(1)}.jocarsa-input-campo{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;padding:10px 12px!important;margin:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;font:15px Arial,sans-serif;color:#222}.jocarsa-input-campo::placeholder{color:#999}.jocarsa-input-tipo{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;color:#888;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;user-select:none}.jocarsa-input-envoltura.invalido{border-color:#a00}.jocarsa-input-envoltura.invalido .jocarsa-input-icono{background:#fff0f0}.jocarsa-input-envoltura.valido:not(.vacio) .jocarsa-input-icono{background:#f3f7f3}.jocarsa-input[aria-disabled=true]{opacity:.55}.jocarsa-input .jocarsa-input-campo[type=color]{height:44px;padding:7px!important;cursor:pointer}.jocarsa-input .jocarsa-input-campo[type=range]{padding:0 12px!important}.jocarsa-input-ayuda{padding:4px 2px 0 48px;font-size:11px;color:#777}
        .jocarsa-hora{max-width:520px}.jocarsa-reloj-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px}.jocarsa-reloj{display:block;width:min(420px,100%);height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}.jocarsa-hora-valor{text-align:center;padding:8px;font:bold 22px monospace;border-top:1px solid #eee}.jocarsa-hora-leyenda{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:20px;padding:0 10px 12px;color:#666;font-size:12px}.jocarsa-hora-leyenda span::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;margin-right:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#333}
      `;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }

    barra(){
      const barra = document.createElement("div");
      barra.className = "jocarsa-barra";
      this.raiz.appendChild(barra);
      return barra;
    }

    boton(barra, texto, fn, titulo=""){
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.innerHTML = texto;
      b.title = titulo;
      b.addEventListener("click", fn);
      barra.appendChild(b);
      return b;
    }

    campoOculto(tipo="textarea"){
      const campo = document.createElement(tipo);
      campo.className = "jocarsa-hidden-input";
      if(this.name) campo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) campo.required = true;
      if(this.disabled) campo.disabled = true;
      campo.value = this.value;
      this.raiz.appendChild(campo);
      this.campo = campo;
      return campo;
    }

    setValue(valor){
      this.value = valor;
      if(this.campo) this.campo.value = valor;
      this.raiz.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("jocarsa-change", {detail:{value:valor}}));
    }
  }

  class JocarsaTexto extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"texto");
      const barra = this.barra();
      const editor = document.createElement("article");
      editor.className = "jocarsa-area";
      editor.contentEditable = !this.disabled;
      editor.innerHTML = this.value;
      if(this.placeholder) editor.dataset.placeholder = this.placeholder;
      this.raiz.appendChild(editor);

      const codigo = document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.style.display = "none";
      codigo.value = this.value;
      if(this.name) codigo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) codigo.required = true;
      this.raiz.appendChild(codigo);
      this.campo = codigo;

      const cmd=(t,c,v=null)=>this.boton(barra,t,()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand(c,false,v);sync();});
      cmd("<b>B</b>","bold"); cmd("<i>I</i>","italic"); cmd("<u>U</u>","underline");
      cmd("H1","formatBlock","h1"); cmd("H2","formatBlock","h2"); cmd("P","formatBlock","p");
      cmd("•","insertUnorderedList"); cmd("1.","insertOrderedList");
      cmd("←","justifyLeft"); cmd("↔","justifyCenter"); cmd("→","justifyRight");
      cmd("↶","undo"); cmd("↷","redo");
      this.boton(barra,"🔗",()=>{const u=prompt("Introduce la URL:");if(u){editor.focus();document.execCommand("createLink",false,u);sync();}});
      this.boton(barra,"Tx",()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand("removeFormat",false,null);sync();});
      this.boton(barra,"&lt;/&gt;",()=>{
        const verCodigo = codigo.style.display === "none";
        if(verCodigo){sync(); editor.style.display="none"; codigo.style.display="block";}
        else{editor.innerHTML=codigo.value; editor.style.display="block"; codigo.style.display="none"; sync();}
      },"Ver HTML");

      const sync=()=>this.setValue(editor.innerHTML);
      editor.addEventListener("input",sync);
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>{this.value=codigo.value;});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaMarkdown extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"markdown");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const preview=document.createElement("div");
      preview.className="jocarsa-preview";
      preview.contentEditable=!this.disabled;
      const codigo=document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.value=this.value;
      if(this.name) codigo.name=this.name;
      if(this.required) codigo.required=true;
      codigo.style.display="none";
      this.raiz.append(preview,codigo);
      this.campo=codigo;

      const escapar=s=>s.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
      const render=md=>{
        let h=escapar(md);
        h=h.replace(/^### (.*)$/gm,"<h3>$1</h3>").replace(/^## (.*)$/gm,"<h2>$1</h2>").replace(/^# (.*)$/gm,"<h1>$1</h1>");
        h=h.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,"<strong>$1</strong>").replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g,"<em>$1</em>").replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,"<code>$1</code>");
        h=h.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2">$1</a>');
        h=h.replace(/^[-*] (.*)$/gm,"<li>$1</li>");
        h=h.replace(/(?:<li>.*<\/li>\n?)+/g,m=>"<ul>"+m+"</ul>");
        return h.split(/\n{2,}/).map(x=>/^<(h\d|ul|ol|blockquote)/.test(x)?x:`<p>${x.replace(/\n/g,"<br>")}</p>`).join("");
      };
      const htmlAMarkdown=()=>{
        let h=preview.innerHTML;
        h=h.replace(/<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/gi,"# $1\n\n").replace(/<h2[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h2>/gi,"## $1\n\n").replace(/<h3[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h3>/gi,"### $1\n\n");
        h=h.replace(/<(strong|b)[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi,"**$2**").replace(/<(em|i)[^>]*>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi,"*$2*");
        h=h.replace(/<a[^>]*href=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*>(.*?)<\/a>/gi,"[$2]($1)");
        h=h.replace(/<li[^>]*>(.*?)<\/li>/gi,"- $1\n").replace(/<br\s*\/?\s*>/gi,"\n").replace(/<\/p>/gi,"\n\n").replace(/<p[^>]*>/gi,"");
        const tmp=document.createElement("div"); tmp.innerHTML=h; return tmp.textContent.replace(/\n{3,}/g,"\n\n").trim();
      };
      const syncPreview=()=>{codigo.value=htmlAMarkdown();this.value=codigo.value;};
      const envolver=(a,b=a)=>{const s=codigo.selectionStart,e=codigo.selectionEnd,t=codigo.value;codigo.value=t.slice(0,s)+a+t.slice(s,e)+b+t.slice(e);codigo.focus();codigo.selectionStart=s+a.length;codigo.selectionEnd=e+a.length;this.setValue(codigo.value);};
      this.boton(barra,"<b>B</b>",()=>envolver("**")); this.boton(barra,"<i>I</i>",()=>envolver("*"));
      this.boton(barra,"H1",()=>envolver("# ","")); this.boton(barra,"H2",()=>envolver("## ",""));
      this.boton(barra,"🔗",()=>{const u=prompt("Introduce la URL:");if(u) envolver("[","]("+u+")");});
      this.boton(barra,"MD",()=>{
        if(codigo.style.display==="none"){syncPreview();preview.style.display="none";codigo.style.display="block";}
        else{this.setValue(codigo.value);preview.innerHTML=render(codigo.value);codigo.style.display="none";preview.style.display="block";}
      },"Código Markdown / WYSIWYG");
      preview.innerHTML=render(this.value);
      preview.addEventListener("input",syncPreview);
      codigo.addEventListener("input",()=>{this.value=codigo.value;});
    }
  }

  class JocarsaEditor extends JocarsaControl {
    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"editor");
      const barra=this.barra();
      const lenguaje=elemento.getAttribute("language")||elemento.getAttribute("lenguaje")||"texto";
      const tabSize=Math.max(1,Number(elemento.getAttribute("tab-size")||2));
      const etiqueta=document.createElement("span"); etiqueta.textContent=lenguaje; etiqueta.style.padding="6px"; barra.appendChild(etiqueta);
      const estado=document.createElement("span"); estado.className="jocarsa-editor-estado"; barra.appendChild(estado);
      this.boton(barra,"Copiar",()=>navigator.clipboard?.writeText(codigo.value));

      const cuerpo=document.createElement("div"); cuerpo.className="jocarsa-editor-cuerpo";
      const lineas=document.createElement("pre"); lineas.className="jocarsa-editor-lineas";
      const codigo=document.createElement("textarea");
      codigo.className="jocarsa-codigo"; codigo.spellcheck=false; codigo.value=this.value; codigo.placeholder=this.placeholder; codigo.style.tabSize=tabSize;
      if(this.name) codigo.name=this.name; if(this.required) codigo.required=true; if(this.disabled) codigo.disabled=true;
      cuerpo.append(lineas,codigo); this.raiz.appendChild(cuerpo); this.campo=codigo;

      const actualizar=()=>{
        const total=Math.max(1,codigo.value.split("\n").length);
        lineas.textContent=Array.from({length:total},(_,i)=>i+1).join("\n");
        const pos=codigo.selectionStart, antes=codigo.value.slice(0,pos), partes=antes.split("\n");
        const ln=partes.length, col=partes[partes.length-1].length+1;
        estado.textContent=`Ln ${ln}, Col ${col} · ${total} líneas · Tab ${tabSize}`;
        this.setValue(codigo.value);
      };
      codigo.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{lineas.scrollTop=codigo.scrollTop});
      codigo.addEventListener("input",actualizar);
      codigo.addEventListener("click",actualizar);
      codigo.addEventListener("keyup",actualizar);
      codigo.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
        if(e.key==="Tab"){
          e.preventDefault(); const s=codigo.selectionStart,en=codigo.selectionEnd, sangria=" ".repeat(tabSize);
          if(s===en){codigo.setRangeText(sangria,s,en,"end");}
          else{
            const inicio=codigo.value.lastIndexOf("\n",s-1)+1, finLinea=codigo.value.indexOf("\n",en), fin=finLinea<0?codigo.value.length:finLinea;
            const bloque=codigo.value.slice(inicio,fin);

        }
      });
      actualizar();
    }
  }

  class JocarsaTabla extends JocarsaControl {

      const buscar=document.createElement("input"); buscar.type="search"; buscar.placeholder="Buscar...";

      const cantidad=document.createElement("select"); [5,10,25,50,100].forEach(n=>{const o=document.createElement("option");o.value=n;o.textContent=n;if(n===10)o.selected=true;cantidad.appendChild(o)});
      controles.append(buscar,etiqueta,cantidad); this.raiz.insertBefore(controles,tabla);
      const scroll=document.createElement("div"); scroll.className="jocarsa-tabla-scroll"; tabla.before(scroll); scroll.appendChild(tabla);
      const pie=document.createElement("div"); pie.className="jocarsa-tabla-pie"; const info=document.createElement("span"), pag=document.createElement("div"); pag.className="jocarsa-tabla-paginacion"; pie.append(info,pag); this.raiz.appendChild(pie);
      let pagina=1,orden=-1,direccion=1;
      const valor=v=>{const t=v.trim().replace(",",".");return t!==""&&!isNaN(t)?Number(t):v.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("es")};
      const pintar=()=>{
        let visibles=filas.filter(f=>f.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase("es").includes(buscar.value.toLocaleLowerCase("es")));
        if(orden>=0) visibles.sort((a,b)=>{let x=valor(a.cells[orden]?.textContent||""),y=valor(b.cells[orden]?.textContent||"");return (x<y?-1:x>y?1:0)*direccion});
        filas.forEach(f=>f.style.display="none"); const por=Number(cantidad.value), total=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(visibles.length/por)); pagina=Math.min(pagina,total); const ini=(pagina-1)*por; visibles.slice(ini,ini+por).forEach(f=>f.style.display="");
        info.textContent=`Mostrando ${visibles.length?ini+1:0}-${Math.min(ini+por,visibles.length)} de ${visibles.length}`; pag.innerHTML="";
        const mk=(txt,fn,dis=false)=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.textContent=txt;b.disabled=dis;b.onclick=fn;pag.appendChild(b)}; mk("‹",()=>{pagina--;pintar()},pagina<=1); const n=document.createElement("span");n.style.padding="5px";n.textContent=`${pagina} / ${total}`;pag.appendChild(n);mk("›",()=>{pagina++;pintar()},pagina>=total);
      };
      tabla.querySelectorAll("thead th").forEach((th,i)=>th.addEventListener("click",()=>{tabla.querySelectorAll("thead th").forEach(x=>delete x.dataset.dir);if(orden===i)direccion*=-1;else{orden=i;direccion=1}th.dataset.dir=direccion===1?"asc":"desc";pagina=1;pintar()}));
      buscar.addEventListener("input",()=>{pagina=1;pintar()}); cantidad.addEventListener("change",()=>{pagina=1;pintar()}); pintar();
    }
  }

        valor.textContent=this.seleccion?this.formato(this.seleccion):"Sin fecha seleccionada";

      password: {emoji:"●", native:"password", label:"contraseña", autocomplete:"current-password"},

      search:   {emoji:"⌕", native:"search", label:"búsqueda"},
      integer:  {emoji:"#", native:"number", label:"entero", step:"1", inputmode:"numeric"},
      number:   {emoji:"№", native:"number", label:"número", inputmode:"decimal"},
      decimal:  {emoji:".0", native:"number", label:"decimal", step:"any", inputmode:"decimal"},

      porcentaje:{emoji:"%", native:"number", label:"porcentaje", step:"any", inputmode:"decimal"},

      time:     {emoji:"◷", native:"time", label:"hora"},
      "datetime-local":{emoji:"◫", native:"datetime-local", label:"fecha/hora"},
      month:    {emoji:"M", native:"month", label:"mes"},
      week:     {emoji:"W", native:"week", label:"semana"},
      color:    {emoji:"◐", native:"color", label:"color"},
      range:    {emoji:"↔", native:"range", label:"rango"}
    };

    constructor(elemento){
      super(elemento,"input");
      const solicitado=(elemento.getAttribute("type")||"text").toLowerCase();
      const cfg=JocarsaInput.tipos[solicitado]||JocarsaInput.tipos.text;
